fbec5a4d8abba7b6d831.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

As a leading utility-scale renewable energy Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company, we are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Category Manager for Structural Components to lead sourcing, procurement, category strategy, and supplier relationship management across critical structural and construction equipment categories supporting solar PV, HV, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), and Services projects.
  
  
This role is responsible for developing and executing procurement strategies for structural commodities including trackers, fixed-tilt systems, foundations, steel components, and related construction materials, as well as major construction equipment used to build utility-scale renewable energy projects. Equipment categories may include, but will not be limited to, pile drivers, truss drivers, GPS guidance systems, and robotic conveyance/assembly equipment.
  
  
The Category Manager will partner closely with Engineering, Construction Operations, Fleet, Project Management, and Finance teams to drive supplier selection, execute strategic sourcing initiatives, negotiate commercial agreements, improve total cost of ownership, mitigate supply chain risks, and ensure equipment availability to support project execution.
  
  
This position plays a critical role in delivering competitive project economics, ensuring schedule certainty, and building long-term supplier partnerships that support the company's continued growth and industry leadership.
  
  
This role can be fully remote or hybrid with regular in-office presence in San Diego, CA. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

**Category Strategy & Strategic Sourcing**

* Develop and execute category strategies for structural components and construction equipment aligned with business objectives, project pipelines, and market conditions.
* Lead supplier market analysis, benchmarking, and category intelligence efforts to identify opportunities for cost optimization, innovation, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with Engineering, Construction, Fleet, and Operations teams to define technical requirements, specifications, and sourcing strategies.
* Identify, qualify, and onboard new suppliers to support business growth, geographic expansion, and supply chain resiliency.
* Analyze total cost of ownership, supplier capabilities, manufacturing capacity, and commercial competitiveness when evaluating supplier options.

**Competitive Procurement & Contract Negotiation**

* Lead competitive RFP, RFQ, and bid processes for structural materials, construction equipment, and related services.
* Evaluate supplier proposals and develop recommendation packages utilizing commercial, technical, operational, and risk-based criteria.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, warranties, service agreements, performance guarantees, lead times, and other commercial terms.
* Develop and execute Master Supply Agreements, Strategic Partnership Agreements, Rental Agreements, Fleet Purchasing Agreements, and other procurement contracts.
* Support project-specific procurement activities to ensure timely delivery and alignment with project schedules.

**Construction Equipment Procurement**

* Lead sourcing and procurement of construction equipment supporting utility-scale renewable energy projects, including:
* Pile driving equipment
* Truss driving equipment
* GPS Guidance Systems
* Robotic Conveyance/Assembly equipment
* Evaluate buy versus lease versus rental strategies based on project duration, utilization, and financial objectives.
* Collaborate with Fleet and Operations teams to optimize equipment deployment, lifecycle costs, maintenance support, and asset utilization.
* Negotiate service, maintenance, warranty, and aftermarket support agreements with OEMs and equipment providers.
* Monitor equipment market trends, availability constraints, and technological advancements impacting project execution.

**Supplier Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary commercial interface for strategic suppliers.
* Establish supplier performance metrics and scorecards covering cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, safety, innovation, and sustainability.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive supplier meetings.
* Manage supplier escalations and drive corrective action plans when performance issues arise.
* Build strong collaborative supplier relationships that support continuous improvement and long-term value creation.

**Risk Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks related to capacity constraints, geopolitical factors, logistics disruptions, and commodity market fluctuations.
* Develop contingency sourcing plans for critical materials and equipment.
* Drive procurement process improvements, automation initiatives, and best practices.
* Support forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning activities.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, safety requirements, contractual obligations, and industry regulations.

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, procurement, supply chain management, or supplier relationship management.
* Experience sourcing structural commodities, construction materials, industrial equipment, or capital equipment.
* Demonstrated success leading complex commercial negotiations and supplier agreements.
* Strong analytical, financial, and decision-making skills.
* Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and influencing executive-level decisions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

* Experience within utility-scale solar, renewable energy, EPC, construction, infrastructure, energy, or industrial sectors.
* Experience sourcing heavy construction equipment, fleet assets, or large capital equipment programs.
* Understanding of solar tracker systems, foundations, steel fabrication, and renewable construction methodologies.
* Knowledge of equipment ownership models, fleet lifecycle management, rental strategies, and equipment financing structures.
* Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPM, CSCP, PMP, or equivalent.

**Key Success Factors**

**The successful candidate will demonstrate:**

* Strategic procurement leadership.
* Strong commercial and contract negotiation expertise.
* Deep understanding of construction equipment and industrial supply markets.
* Ability to drive measurable cost savings and value creation.
* Expertise in supplier development and performance management.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities.
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset focused on supporting successful project execution.

3fe56b083c3d1cf38961.description:
### **About Point**

**✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.

**✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.

**✨ Game-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4.7 Trustpilot rating and an A+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000+ customers.

**✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.

**✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week.

  

**Local or 100% Remote**

  

**About the role**

As a Servicing Operations Coordinator II at Point, you'll help homeowners navigate their Home Equity Investments (HEIs), providing clear, empathetic support and resolving complex servicing requests. From payoff inquiries and property sales to appraisal reviews and title-related questions, you'll coordinate with homeowners, external partners, and internal teams to ensure accurate and timely resolutions.

This role combines customer service, document review, and problem-solving. You'll take ownership of servicing issues, maintain accurate records, and help improve workflows as our operations evolve. Success requires sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to balance operational efficiency with a positive homeowner experience.

  

**Your responsibilities**

* Respond to homeowner inquiries regarding Home Equity Investments via phone, email, and internal servicing channels with professionalism, empathy, and accuracy.
* Handle more complex or escalated homeowner servicing requests, including payoff inquiries, appraisal reviews, title-related questions, sales transaction coordination, and servicing disputes.
* Make outbound calls to homeowners, real estate agents, escrow/title companies, insurance providers, and local counties as necessary to resolve servicing matters.
* Review and process HEI-related servicing documentation, including valuation reports, sales contracts, payoff requests, insurance documents, authorization forms, and other servicing records.
* Analyze sales contracts, appraisals, title information, and supporting documentation for accuracy, completeness, and servicing risk considerations.
* Support payoff and property sale workflows while ensuring adherence to servicing timelines and operational requirements.
* Assist homeowners facing financial or operational challenges with empathy, professionalism, and strong customer service.
* Investigate and resolve servicing exceptions, discrepancies, and operational issues with minimal supervision.
* Help identify process improvement opportunities and provide feedback on servicing workflows, tooling, and operational efficiencies.
* Utilize Point's proprietary servicing systems and operational tools to maintain accurate servicing records and ensure proper documentation.

  

**About you**

* Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to work independently, solve problems, and use available resources effectively.

* Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.

ad0fe14d65a71c5ba303.description:
Customer Service Representative - Call Center

**About KBS**

**Kellermeyer Bergensons Services (KBS) is the largest privately held provider of facility services in North America, servicing over 2 billion square feet of space daily**. We help industry leaders across a wide range of key verticals—including **retail, industrial and logistics, healthcare, education, manufacturing, and more**—maintain clean, efficient, and welcoming spaces that support their operations. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for team members who are dedicated, reliable, and ready to contribute to a culture built on respect, opportunity, and pride in service.

If this sounds like you, then why wait, APPLY TODAY!!

**This is a 100% remote job opportunity**

**Position Summary**

The Customer Service Representative position requires exceptional interpersonal skills and attention to detail. The position’s primary objectives is to ensure the established service level agreements (SLA), data integrity and communication are adhered to. The position focuses on direct communication with customers and vendors, project scheduling, and coordination across departments to foster optimized interaction with customers. The Customer Service Representative sees the customer service process from many angles and offers feedback on the efficacy of current procedures.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Job responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Responsible for accurate and timely creation and management of Service Records, Service Orders, Case Records, IVR Management, Client Work Order systems and QA Calls
* Communicates directly with customers and vendors via phone or email
* Assesses and responds promptly to customer inquiries, comments, and complaints, with the ability to properly triage requests based on urgency
* Obtains and evaluates all relevant information to effectively address customer service inquiries, comments, or complaints
* Handles and resolves customer complaints quickly and professionally, with follow up to ensure that complaints were resolved to the customer’s satisfaction
* Schedules and monitors the completion of customer projects with assigned and existing KBS vendors
* Escalates any projects on the executive weekly reports that need crew assignments to corresponding field managers and Strategic Account Managers
* Identifies, records, and tracks unresolved complaints, and directs them to the appropriate resource for resolution
* Maintains detailed records of written or verbal customer communication, noting the communication date, reason, action(s) taken, and next step(s), if applicable
* Stay abreast of what is working and what is not working and make recommendations to bring greater efficiencies through continuous improvements
* Communicates and coordinates with internal departments regarding customer inquiries, comments, and complaints, project scheduling, compliance, and any other relevant issues central to improving the customer experience

**Additional Duties and Responsibilities**

Perform other related duties as required and assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills and Competencies**

*Knowledge:*

* Facilities Maintenance industry
* Customer service call center operations

*Skills:*

* Interpersonal, listening, and conflict management (EQ)
* Stress management
* Written and oral communication
* Mathematical, analytical and problem-solving skills
* Detail focus
* Data entry accuracy and editing skills
* Management reporting
* Microsoft Office programs to include, but not limited to Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, with an emphasis on Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Graphs, etc.)

Competencies:

* Dealing with ambiguity
* Action Oriented
* Integrity and Trust
* Customer focus
* Priority setting
* Time management

**Educational Qualifications/Job Experience Requirements**

*Experience Required:*

* Knowledge of customer service principles and practices
* 1-2 years’ experience and knowledge of administrative procedures

*Education:*

* High School Diploma, General Education Degree, or equivalent; Bachelor’s Degree is a plus
* Demonstrated keyboarding skills of at least 40wpm
* Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists

**Working Conditions/Physical Requirements**

*Schedule:*

* Schedule varies and includes weekends or holidays as needed.

The working conditions and physical environments described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

*Physical Demands:*

* Extended periods of work seated at a desk; repetitive hand motions; prolonged use of computer; occasionally lift and carry up to 25 lbs.
* Ability to speak clearly (use of voice)
* Vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, moderate peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus

*Working Environment:*

* Office environment generally mild to moderate conditions including varying temperatures and noise levels conducive to a busy workplace and office equipment
* Lighting varies based on building requirements and may be adjusted within reason
* Time constraints and related pressures to complete work are high

*Travel:* <5%

The base hourly pay range above represents the minimum and maximum of the pay range for this position. Actual placement within this range will vary based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, and geographic location. Hourly rates may vary based upon state/local minimum wage restrictions. Final hourly rate of pay will be discussed and determined during the hiring process. Hourly employees will be eligible for overtime pay in accordance with applicable law and KBS policy.

**Job Summary**

Our Customer Care Specialists — also known as "Comfort Gurus" — deliver world-class, professional support across every part of Purple's service and support center. Specialists may be placed on core servicing (calls, chats, email), warranty, shipping, or returns teams, but no matter the assignment, every specialist is focused on making sure customers get top-notch care at each touch point. It's a role for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and thrives on solving problems.

* Responds to customer inquiries via phone, chat, email, text, or social media, taking appropriate action to ensure world-class service.
* Provides detailed notes and documentation for each customer interaction.
* Maintains acceptable customer satisfaction and quality monitoring ratings.
* Maintains acceptable productivity, schedule adherence, and utilization levels.
* Meets all individual performance metrics.
* Maintains in-depth, current knowledge of all products, procedures, and policies, including warranty, returns, and refunds.
* Works cross-functionally across chat, email, and phone channels.
* Works in office through training and initial certification, and as needed for additional training, collaboration, or team meetings.

***What we’re looking for (*****Requirements, skills, & education):**

* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with customers on a variety of post-purchase questions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Solid ability to identify what a customer needs, problem-solve, and create approved solutions that provide an excellent experience.
* Ability to maintain strong mental fortitude through challenging or stressful interactions.
* Proficient with basic computer hardware and able to quickly learn job-specific software systems.
* High School Diploma or GED; some college preferred.

***Even Better if... (*****Preferred skills and experience):**

* Experience with systems such as inContact, NetSuite, and Zendesk.
* Customer service experience, particularly in a call center environment.
* Some sales experience.
* Typing speed of 40 words per minute or more.

This full-time position is expected to work approximately **30-40 hours per week.** This is a good faith estimate, and actual hours may vary based on business needs.

**BENEFITS AND PERKS**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* 401(k) Match
* Paid Time Off
* Earn a Mattress
* Purple Swag
* Amazing Purple Products

* **Make your mark:** We value innovative thinking. At Purple, you will be empowered to bring your ideas to life as we work together to improve people’s lives through comfort.

f2caf10c6dac9c951d6f.title: Customer Care Specialist - MedStar Unified Revenue Cycle Organization
f2caf10c6dac9c951d6f.description:
About this Job:

MedStar Health is seeking highly **qualified, experienced, and customer-focused professionals** to join our **Customer Service** ***Call Center*** **team** as a Customer Care Specialist. **Medical billing experience and knowledge are essential for this position.** We are looking for a candidate with a demonstrated background in medical billing, exceptional customer service skills, and the ability to confidently and professionally handle customer inquiries.

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:30 AM–6:00 PM

As a Customer Care Specialist, you will serve as the primary post-service contact for the MedStar Health Customer Service Call Center. Identifies the nature of inquiries, discerns potential implications for internal & external entities. Using both MedStar billing systems (IDX and SMS), internal/external resources, applications, and processes to resolve cases. Provides a single point of contact from origin through final resolution for all patient billing, coding, service, and insurance concerns. Uses appropriate guidelines and discretionary authority to make decisions concerning proper resolution of documented service recovery cases. Special emphasis on educating the patient, building rapport and service recovery is all aimed at enhancing the patient experience.

Primary Duties:

* Advocates on the patients’ behalf to achieve best results, gain patients’ trust and build rapport. Interacts regularly with patients, MedStar Health staff from all areas, collection agency liaisons, website vendors, outside labs, etc. Uses established guidelines to make independent decisions concerning specific patient issues in need of resolution. Answers and resolves patient/guarantor inquiries daily, via telephone, mail, fax, and email. Meets the departmental weekly standards for calls taken, mail handled, and other forms of customer contacts resolved. Meets specific standard turnaround times as they apply to number of calls answered, speed of answer, hold time, personal call abandonment rate, etc. Meets expected turnaround times for resolving interdepartmental issues, cases deemed “urgent” or in need of special handling, and response time to customers.

* Serves as the single point of contact for the patient. Liaises, advocates, research, and analyzes documents, records, prior precedent-setting cases, discusses and reviews with both internal and external sources, etc., until final adjudication or resolution is achieved. Uses MedStar Health's billing systems and the MedStar Payment Portal to help customers with their billing and payment concerns. Annotates invoice or account after each inquiry to ensure proper documentation of inquiries and resolutions. Ensures correct upload of documents for proper retention. Knowledge of the functions of all MedStar Health’s non-telephony methods of customer contact.

* Applies knowledge of MedStar Health’s Managed Care contracts and the associated rules for claim processing to achieve proper reimbursement and customer satisfaction. Participates in training sessions, workshops offered, staff meetings, work events, task force, committees, and community outreach efforts. Communicates to leadership any system or procedural problems/inconsistencies to prevent problem recurrence and/or to improve existing processes. Corrects invoices and accounts in both systems that have erroneous registration and/or insurance information and ensures all associated claims have the correct financial classification for timely processing/reprocessing.

* Exemplifies Spirit Values in all activities in areas of service, resource utilization, high quality outcomes and effective communication. Interviews patients in need of referral or recommendation to appropriate support and/or charity care programs. Proposes budget/payment plans to customers as the situation warrants and in accordance with MURCO policies and Maryland State regulations. Keeps abreast of regulatory and specific changes as they relate to HCFA 1500 and UB04 billing requirements and payer-specific follow-up. Maintains departmental QA standards within established error rate. Meets the established standards for abandoned calls, duration of calls and the amount of time that patient is held in queue, etc.

Qualifications:

* High School Diploma or GED
* 2 years’ experience in patient accounting or related healthcare field.
* 1 year of customer service experience.
* Associate or bachelor's degree preferred.

This position has a hiring range of : USD $20.57 - USD $36.27 /Hr.

b54725d8253c2cac8cc3.title: Customer Care Professional (remote)
b54725d8253c2cac8cc3.description:
This **customer service and sales** role is great for top-notch, smart, quick, go-getters who love to sell and help customers! As a full-time **Customer Care Professional (CCP)**, you will work remotely handling inbound customer service and sales, with all equipment and training provided. You will begin with a four-week live online training program, followed by continued hands-on learning as you take calls and gain a deeper understanding of both the role and our business. This position is available to candidates residing in **AL, AZ, CA, CT, FL, GA, KY, NC, NJ, NM, NV, SC, TX, or VA**.

You must be available to work a four-week training shift, Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Pacific Time. After the initial training, you must have ongoing availability Monday through Friday within the hours of 6:00 a.m. to 5:15 p.m. Pacific Time.

In this role, you will provide exceptional customer service and product support to Notary customers while also assisting with inbound sales inquiries. Successful CCPs are sociable, professional, and skilled at communicating information clearly and confidently. You will thrive in this position if you enjoy working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and take pride in delivering a positive customer experience. Because this is a remote position, you should be comfortable working independently, navigating computer systems efficiently, and managing multiple priorities. You should also be open to regular call monitoring for quality control and coaching to support your continued development and ensure our commitment to customer service excellence.

At the **National Notary Association (NNA)**, we want this to be your *Best Job Ever!* Our company culture is reflected in the many employees who have built long-term careers with us. We offer a comprehensive benefits program that includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; paid time off and paid holidays; unlimited commission potential; and a 401(k) plan with company match and profit sharing. Our call center offers opportunities for growth across the organization, and we are committed to helping you succeed.

**About Us:** The NNA is the leading authority on the American Notary office, dedicated to imparting knowledge, building community, and promoting sound professional standards of practice for the benefit and protection of the public.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

* Answer a high volume of telephone inquiries from potential notaries and current customers regarding sales and/or support
* Resolve product or service issues through identification and efficient resolution
* Deliver high-quality customer service in a warm, caring, and professional manner
* Achieve sales goals by upselling and cross-selling products and services to customers while explaining the features and benefits
* Comply and adhere to the NNA’s ethics and security policies
* Maintain positive relationships with both internal and external customers
* Complete additional training throughout the year relevant to CCP duties
* Adhere to the Call Center Attendance Policy, Selling with Integrity, and Quality of Service Standards
* Contribute to team projects when assigned and perform other administrative duties as needed
* Contribute to a positive working environment, making this the Best Job Ever for self and others

**WHAT YOU MUST HAVE**

* High school diploma or GED required
* 2 years minimum prior call center experience is highly preferred
* A reliable at-home internet connection with direct Ethernet capability (not Wi-Fi) and a dedicated workspace that is safe, quiet, and ergonomically appropriate for performing your job duties
* Must be comfortable answering phone calls consistently, up to 8 hours per day
* Must be able to work within the set schedule provided.
* Prior sales experience is highly preferred
* Typing speed 35 WPM or more
* Must be proficient with MS Office, and comfortable working with computers and quickly learning a variety of programs
* You will be able to demonstrate problem-solving abilities and the ability to work both independently and as a team

**WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE**

* Strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both written and verbal
* Possess a passion for helping others
* Have a strong sense of urgency in resolving customer concerns
* Show empathy and advocacy for our customers
* Possess persuasive selling skills
* Possess excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

**YOU ARE ABLE TO**

* Comprehend and remember detailed and/or complex processes
* Define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
* Handle multiple tasks in a dynamic environment
* Work with minimal supervision and meet goals and objectives
* Work in groups to achieve positive results
* Be receptive to feedback and demonstrate emotional control

**ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:**

* Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV to be considered
* Must be willing to submit to a background investigation
* Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States

**SALARY:**

* $18.47 per hour
* Plus commission

***REMARKS:*** *The Company reserves the right to add, delete or modify duties and job requirements at any time. An applicant must meet the minimum job requirements of the job for which he or she is applying. Moreover, the Company may, as it deems appropriate in its sole discretion, evaluate whether an incumbent continues to satisfy the minimum job requirements of the job that he/she holds. With respect to a request for reasonable accommodation, the Company will evaluate whether the applicant or employee can perform the essential functions of the subject job with or without reasonable accommodation. The Company’s evaluation of a request for reasonable accommodation will include engaging in the interactive process with the applicant or employee.*

**For us, this is more than a job– it’s a calling. It’s waking up each day, looking for ways to make a difference with a compassionate, inclusive and talented team. Ochsner empowers you to discover your passion, reach your potential, and Pursue Your Purpose. Exceptional care starts with exceptional people and teams. Together we are leading the way.**

This job greets patients and guest in a courteous manner whether via telephone contact or in person; initiates scheduling an appointment or completing the check-in process/admission for patients; obtains and verifies accurate identification and demographical data for the patient’s permanent medical record which assist in accurate reimbursement while recognizing the necessity of maintaining the confidentiality of all patient information. Responsible for point-of-service collections, face-to-face patient interactions related to completing the patient registration and admission process; responsible for the verification of insurance via electronic verification, telephone, or web application; improves patient satisfaction through consistently representing the company professionally and cross trained to support multiple functions across all patient and payer types.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

This job description is a summary of the primary duties and responsibilities of the job and position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive or all-inclusive listing of duties and responsibilities. Contents are subject to change at the company's discretion.

**Education**

Required – High school diploma or equivalent

Preferred – Associate’s degree

**Work Experience**

Required – Minimum of 1 year of experience in a hospital, clinic, medical office, business services/revenue cycle, or other customer service-related environment. Experience may include front line registration, financial counseling, banking, retail, or similar roles involving direct customer or patient interaction.

**Certifications**

Preferred - Certification in Healthcare Access Manager (CHAM), Certification in Healthcare Access Associate (CHAA), Certification as a Medical Assistant (or other medical specialty-based certification)

**Knowledge Skills and Abilities (KSAs)**

* Must have computer skills and dexterity required for data entry and retrieval of information.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills and the ability to present information clearly and professionally.
* Must be proficient with Windows-style applications, various software packages specific to role and keyboard.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Must have clerical skills and exhibit technical knowledge of healthcare insurance benefits, various payor guidelines on referral and authorization processes as well as have current knowledge of Federal, State and Local billing regulations.
* Skills to effectively present information and respond to questions from patients and customers, with proficiency.
* Skills to solve practical problems and deal with high stress situations while maintaining a high quality of professionalism.
* Good organizational, time management, and conflict resolution skills.
* Excellent decision making skills; good analytical skills with a strong attention to detail are necessary.
* Ability to work collaboratively with other departments.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment in handling/escalating difficult situations.

**Job Duties**

* Provide excellent customer service to all patients, guests, and family members.
* Create, activate, and complete the patient scheduling, clinic registration, or hospital admission process.
* Ensures all required forms are completed and other paperwork/documents are gathered and accurate.
* Efficiently and accurately gathers and inputs patient/guarantor demographic and financial information; explains insurance benefits and collects co-pays, deductibles and self-pay portions due.

Barefoot Bridal specializes in destination weddings in the Caribbean and Mexico. We assist guests with getting to the wedding, but we are not wedding planners. Our goal is to provide superior customer service to brides and their guests without sacrificing efficiency.

We are a fully remote business with agents and employees across the world and are excited to add a new Customer Service Representative/Administrative Assistant to the team, known as our "Client Experience Concierges."

As a Client Experience Concierge, you will be the face of the company, providing exceptional service to all external customer contacts by answering e-mails, text messages, and phone calls regarding their bookings. You will also be assisting the agents with their needs as it relates to the business.

You will be working 40 hours a week Monday through Friday during regular business hours. You can start anytime between 9am to 12pm EST once training has been completed. However, your training schedule will be 930am EST start time.

Datascan is a technology company whose mission is to help businesses make better inventory decisions one scan at a time. Through the provision of configurable software, fit-for-purpose scanning hardware, and access to real-time data, Datascan is the cost effective, high value option for retailers looking to take advantage of the accuracy, efficiency, and flexibility of our industry-leading inventory solutions.

We operate using several key drivers for success which include -

* Establishing lasting, collaborative client relationships that consistently exceed expectations,
* Continually striving for excellence through innovation, technical expertise, industry knowledge and a relentless commitment to client care,
* Being easy to do business with, in all that we do,
* Attracting, developing, and retaining passionate, talented people in a culture of empowerment that inspires, challenges, and recognizes the contribution of every member of the Datascan team.

Backed by private equity and with over 50 years of experience serving retailers, Datascan is the global leader in providing technology-led inventory counting solutions to world class retailers in over 42 countries.

Position Summary

The Customer Service Associate should be a motivated and customer-focused individual specializing in our SAAS product. In this role, you will be responsible for providing exceptional service to our customers, assisting them with technical issues, and ensuring their overall satisfaction. This is an entry-level position that offers excellent growth opportunities within our organization.

Duties and Responsibilities

* Handle incoming customer inquiries and issues via phone, email, and chat, providing prompt and accurate responses
* Identify and troubleshoot technical problems reported by customers, working closely with more senior team members to resolve issues effectively
* Guide customers through product features and functionalities, explaining processes and providing step-by-step instructions
* Ensure high customer satisfaction by maintaining a friendly and professional demeanor, actively listening to customers' concerns, and taking appropriate actions to address them
* Document customer interactions, including details of inquiries, issues, and resolutions, in our customer relationship management (CRM) system
* Continuously expand product knowledge to stay up-to-date with new features and enhancements, enabling you to provide accurate and relevant information to customers.
* Identify opportunities for improvement in customer service processes and workflows, contributing to the enhancement of customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
* Meet or exceed individual and team performance metrics, including response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction ratings.
* Performs additional duties as assigned to support business needs
* Education – High school diploma or equivalent; relevant certifications or technical degrees are a plus.
* Years of experience – entry level

* Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts in a clear and understandable manner
* Problem-solving and analytical skills to diagnose and troubleshoot customer issues effectively
* Empathy, patience, and a customer-centric mindset to handle customer inquiries and concerns with professionalism and empathy
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, multitask, and prioritize workload effectively
* Familiarity with SAAS products, cloud computing concepts, and basic technical terminology is preferred
* Proficiency in using CRM systems and other customer support tools is a plus
* Availability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, based on customer demand

Work Ownership & Representation

Employees are hired based on their individual qualifications, including education, experience, and demonstrated ability to perform the responsibilities of the role. As such, the duties and responsibilities assigned to the employee must be performed by the employee themselves. Under no circumstances may work be subcontracted, delegated, or otherwise assigned to a third party without prior written authorization from the company.

Full Time/Part Time

Full time (40 hours per week).

Exempt/Non-Exempt

Non-Exempt

Work Location and Hours

* This role’s schedule corresponds with the assigned shift in the 24/7 support schedule. This position may require periodic off shift working hours in the form of Service level overflow assistance. To maintain consistent delivery of customer support between the shifts, off hour collaboration with other shift supervisors will be required, and timing of such meetings will be determined by a collective agreement between the parties.

* This position is a remote position with occasional work from the office for business need. Employees may be required to attend in-person meetings, trainings, or other business-related activities at designated company locations from time to time. Advance notice will be provided for any required onsite presence. All employees are expected to comply with these in-person requirements as part of their role.
* For remote positions, a primary work state must be established. Employees who wish to work remotely from a state other than their designated primary work state must obtain prior approval from Datascan. Approval is not guaranteed and may be denied based on business, legal, tax, or compliance considerations.

Physical Requirements

Work will be done primarily seated. Ability to walk around and move items as required when in the office – setting up meeting rooms, meals, and such. This role requires long periods of viewing a computer screen, working on a keyboard, and talking to various individuals.

Core Values

All qualifies applicants must embody the characteristics outlined in our Core Values –

**Ownership** - We care, are accountable, and persevere.

* We take responsibility. We don’t wait - We are empowered to act.
* At Datascan, Details matter!

**Collaboration** – We are team-oriented, easy to work with, and open.

* We work together, ask how we can help, and celebrate as a team.
* At Datascan, Different perspectives matter!

**Execution with Excellence** – We are focused, relentless, and dedicated.

* We have a vision. We know what we want to achieve. We have the right people for the job. We question the status quo and embrace change.
* At Datascan, We measure what matters!

**Solution- Oriented** – We see solutions, not just problems. We have a positive attitude. We innovate.

* We ask the right question, focus on results, and welcome change.
* At Datascan, Doing what it takes to get the job done matters!

**Do What’s Right** – We make good decisions, act with integrity, and have respect.

* We behave in a way that does the right thing for our company, our people, and our customers.
* At Datascan, Doing the right thing matters!

82943bea31c08cf8f691.title: IT Manager
82943bea31c08cf8f691.description:
**About Us:**

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care's mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor's relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors' offices.

**Our Values:**

* *Empathy* *is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.*
* *Collaboration* *is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other's strengths.*
* *Resilience* *reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.*

**The Role:**

We are seeking an IT Manager to own day-to-day IT operations, user lifecycle management (onboarding/offboarding), and identity & access management (IAM) for our growing, distributed team.

This is a hands-on, one-person IT and security function. For now, you will be the sole technical resource and the primary point of contact for all IT and security matters, owning the processes end-to-end. As the function grows, there is the opportunity to build and lead a team beneath you. You will report directly to the CISO and serve as their key operational partner on access and security matters.

This role goes beyond execution; you'll set the standards, own the processes end-to-end, and serve as the primary technical escalation point. You'll be provisioning and deprovisioning accounts, managing devices through Intune, driving IAM strategy, managing endpoint security, and making sure the right people have the right access at the right time.

The ideal candidate is senior enough to operate independently from day one with no ramp-up required. You've operated as the sole or senior IT resource at a startup, are comfortable wearing every hat, owning ambiguous problems independently, documenting your work, and balancing reactive support with proactive process improvement.

**Schedule:** Mon-Fri 8am-5pm ET, and as needed to respond to urgent issues. This role requires living in the **Eastern Time Zone**.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **IT Support & Operations**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation lead for Tier 1-3 technical support requests via ticketing systems
* Support end users across both Windows and macOS environments, including hardware, OS, and application issues
* Troubleshoot connectivity, printing, email, and general software/access issues
* Triage and resolve tickets within defined SLAs, owning escalation paths for complex issues
* Own documentation standards: maintain clear records of common issues, fixes, and internal how-to guides

#### **User Lifecycle Management & IAM**

* Own end-to-end onboarding/offboarding: training for new hires on company systems, account provisioning, device setup, and access control for new hires and departing employees
* Own identity and access management (IAM) strategy, including periodic user access reviews, role/permission assignment, and timely deprovisioning
* Apply and enforce least-privilege principles when granting or reviewing access to systems and applications
* Support SSO configuration and troubleshoot SaaS application access issues
* Maintain accurate records of who has access to what

#### **Device, Endpoint Management & Security**

* Administer Microsoft Intune (MDM) and O365 for a remote, multi-OS device fleet
* Set and enforce security policies across endpoints, including encryption, patching, and compliance configurations
* Deploy, monitor, and manage Microsoft Defender across managed devices
* Own patch management across the fleet
* Handle physical logistics for company devices, including shipping/receiving equipment for new hires, offboarding, and repairs
* Own device inventory tracking and lifecycle management of company hardware, including procurement recommendations
* Manage Google Workspace users, groups, and settings
* Maintain and troubleshoot core SaaS tools used across the organization

#### **Security**

* Apply strong security fundamentals across endpoints, identity, and access, including encryption, patching, MFA/conditional access, and least-privilege enforcement
* Partner with the CISO on access-related security requests and remediation items
* Serve as the operational owner of endpoint and identity security

#### **Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of IT support/operations experience, including experience as the senior or sole IT resource
* Startup experience, having operated as the "one-person IT department" handling infrastructure, security, device management, IAM, and end-user support simultaneously without a larger team to lean on
* Strong working knowledge of security fundamentals: endpoint protection, identity/access security, encryption, patch management, and security best practices in a remote-first environment
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender and endpoint security, patch management, Microsoft Intune, Google Workspace administration
* Experience supporting both Windows and macOS environments
* Experience owning IAM / access management strategy and end-to-end onboarding/offboarding processes, ticketing systems, and managing work within SLAs
* Understanding of PHI and HIPAA
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical staff and represent IT to leadership
* Customer service orientation with the ability to remain patient, empathetic, and reassuring when supporting the team
* Willingness to ship, receive, and temporarily store company equipment (e.g., laptops) at their home as part of device lifecycle logistics
* Ability to work independently, own ambiguous problems, and manage competing priorities in a remote environment
* Must be based in the United States, Eastern Time Zone

#### **Tools & Vendors**

* Microsoft Intune
* Microsoft Defender
* Microsoft O365
* Google Workspace
* Slack
* Atera (patch management)

#### **Nice to Have**

d77324ff3bcff5aa8bcd.title: Customer Service Specialist - Remote
d77324ff3bcff5aa8bcd.description:
**Job title:** Customer Service Specialist

**Position level:** Mid-level (experienced)

**Experience required:** 2+ years of customer service for an online retailer

**Employment type:** Full-time, hourly

**Location:** Fully remote

**Reports to:** Director of Customer Experience

At Local Crafts, we believe in saying “YES” to our customers whenever we can. Great customer service means being friendly, knowledgeable, and accurate, setting the right expectations while creating a welcoming, supportive experience for our diverse community of makers. **Our team is dedicated to helping our customers love what they make. If you’re passionate about problem-solving, teamwork, and the craft community, we’d love to hear from you!**

**Job overview**

We’re not just about providing support; we’re focused on creating a great experience. As a Customer Service Specialist, you’ll be the voice of our company across phone, email, and live chat. You’ll help customers place orders, navigate our websites, answer questions about yarn, fabric, and crafting products, resolve shipping and payment issues, and ensure every interaction reflects our values of care and creativity.

Our Customer Service team supports multiple brands under the Local Crafts umbrella, and you will play a key role in shaping a consistent, positive experience for them all.

**What you’ll do**

* Support customers across multiple brands by phone, email, web forms, and live chat.
* Provide knowledgeable, accurate, timely, and friendly responses.
* Use sound judgment to resolve issues, offer the right solution (such as a replacement, refund, or credit), and escalate when needed.
* Answer questions about knitting, crochet, and quilting tools, techniques, and patterns.
* Use in-house systems to enter orders, update account details, track shipments, and explain return processes.
* Write clear, thoughtful responses that reflect our brand voice, knowing that emails and chats may be shared publicly.
* Collaborate with teammates and other departments to ensure smooth resolution of customer issues.
* Take on special projects or additional tasks as needed.

**Your first 3 months**

* **Month 1:** Learn our product lineup across 7+ brands and our order and ticketing systems, and begin handling email and chat contacts using your existing customer service skills.
* **Month 2:** Independently handle calls and resolve common issues such as shipping questions, order placement, returns, and promotions.
* **Month 3:** Handle complex tickets, know when to apply exceptions, and write thoughtful, personalized responses that require research or collaboration.

**About us**

**Local Crafts** is the parent of a variety of well-known brands, including Connecting Threads, Knit Picks, Crochet.com, Superior Threads, Berroco, Jimmy Beans Wool, Madelinetosh, and DellaQ. Our hands-on approach helps us provide fabrics, threads, yarns, and tools that meet our customers’ preferences while maintaining exceptional quality. Available through dedicated consumer websites, Amazon, wholesale distributors, local retail partners, and consumer shows, our products are loved by craft enthusiasts at every level. We help our customers love what they make!

As an equal opportunity employer, **Local Crafts** is committed to creating and maintaining a supportive and inclusive work environment. We empower each team member to reach their full potential and foster an atmosphere that inspires creativity among our customers.

**Why join us?**

* Be part of a supportive, creative, and customer-focused team.
* Work remotely with a regular full-time schedule.
* Work across multiple well-loved craft brands and a wide variety of customer needs.
* Broaden your craft industry expertise across multiple brands.

**What you will bring**

* 2+ years recent experience handling customer contacts by chat, email, and phone for an online retailer.
* Experience resolving order, shipping, and return issues independently, with minimal oversight.
* Familiarity with knitting, crochet, or quilting tools and techniques.
* Strong computer and web navigation skills; comfortable adapting to new systems.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Clear, accurate writing with strong spelling, grammar, and attention to detail.
* Collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable multitasking in a fast-paced environment.
* **Bonus skills (preferred)**
  + Experience with **Zendesk** or similar CS platforms.
  + Experience with **NetSuite**, **Shopify**, or other order management systems.
  + Advanced knitting or crochet knowledge, with ability to read, troubleshoot, and explain patterns.

**We offer a generous benefits package**, including:

* Starting pay range: $19.00 to $20.00/hr., depending on your geographical location, experience, and other qualifications.
* Multiple medical, dental, and vision plan options after 30 days **(with company contributions to the premium costs)**
* Healthcare Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts
* Company-paid Life, Short and Long-Term Disability, and worldwide travel assistance benefits
* Voluntary life and income replacement plans
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan **with Employer Match**
* Paid time off and holiday pay
* **Employee discounts at all Local Crafts companies!**

  
Work Schedule: Saturday - Wednesday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PT

6c2b6ff03669f3928994.title: Behavioral Health Outreach Coordinator
6c2b6ff03669f3928994.description:
Part-Time Recovery Housing Outreach & Referral Coordinator

**Job Type:** Part-time / Contract  
**Hours:** Approximately 15–20 hours per week  
**Pay:** $20–$30 per hour, depending on experience, with performance bonuses available  
**Location:** Remote

We are looking for an outgoing, organized, and persistent **Outreach & Referral Coordinator** to help build referral relationships for our structured sober/recovery living homes.

Your primary responsibility will be calling and developing relationships with **addiction treatment centers, detox facilities, IOP/PHP programs, hospitals, Drug Courts, probation departments, reentry programs, case managers, MAT providers, behavioral-health organizations, and other community partners**.

This is **not a traditional telemarketing position**. We are looking for someone who can build professional relationships, identify the correct decision-makers, follow up consistently, and help get our recovery homes added to local referral and community-resource networks.

Responsibilities

* Make outbound calls and emails to potential referral partners.
* Identify discharge planners, case managers, community outreach representatives, probation officers, treatment coordinators, and other appropriate contacts.
* Introduce our recovery housing program professionally.
* Ask organizations how we can become an approved or recognized housing resource.
* Send program information, availability, admission criteria, and other requested materials.
* Maintain detailed notes on every conversation and follow-up.
* Follow up consistently with referral partners.
* Build long-term relationships rather than simply making one-time calls.
* Track referrals and help identify which relationships are producing residents.
* Communicate regularly with management regarding outreach activity and results.

Ideal Candidate

We care most about **communication skills, confidence on the phone, relationship-building ability, and consistent follow-up**.

Experience in any of the following is strongly preferred but not required:

**Behavioral health, addiction treatment, recovery services, sober living, healthcare outreach, treatment-center admissions, community outreach, social services, case management, home health, hospice, senior living, recruiting, B2B sales, or referral-based business development.**

You should be comfortable calling organizations where the first person answering the phone may not know who handles housing referrals. You must be willing to professionally ask questions, navigate through departments, locate the correct person, and follow up until a relationship is established.

Requirements

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Comfortable making a high volume of professional outbound calls.
* Friendly, confident, and persistent without being pushy.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable working independently.
* Able to maintain accurate notes and contact records.
* Basic computer, email, and CRM/spreadsheet skills.
* Professional phone presence.
* Genuine interest in helping people access stable recovery housing.

Preferred Experience

Experience working with **treatment centers, behavioral-health providers, hospitals, probation/court systems, recovery programs, or healthcare referral networks** is a major plus.

Candidates with previous **community liaison, outreach, admissions, business development, referral coordinator, or healthcare marketing experience** are especially encouraged to apply.

Compensation

**$20–$30/hour depending on experience.**

Performance bonuses may also be available based on successful referral relationships and qualified resident placements.

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a short answer to this question:

**You call a probation department and the receptionist says, “I’m not sure who handles sober-living or housing referrals.” What would you say next?**

We are looking for someone who knows how to **get to the right person, build the relationship, and follow up consistently.**

* **You call a treatment center and the receptionist gives you the name and email of the discharge planner. What would you do next, and how would you follow up if you don’t hear back?**
* **A referral partner tells you, “We already have several sober-living homes that we refer to.” How would you respond and try to build a relationship without being pushy?**
* **You’ve contacted the same organization three times and still haven’t reached the right person. What would you do next?**
* **A case manager asks, “Why should I refer someone to your recovery home instead of another one?” How would you answer?**
* **You speak with a great referral contact who says, “Send me your information and I’ll keep it on file.” What steps would you take after the call to turn that conversation into an ongoing referral relationship?**

**About the Company**  
OpenQuite is a recovery housing company providing structured, drug- and alcohol-free residences for adults who need a stable environment while rebuilding their lives. We work with treatment providers, case managers, courts, probation departments, hospitals, and other community partners to help connect appropriate residents with housing.

https://openquite.com/

**About OpenQuite**  
OpenQuite is not a detox, treatment center, or clinical facility. Our homes provide structure, accountability, peer support, and onsite house management in a recovery-focused living environment.

Pay: $25.77 - $31.03 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 25.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

9e385b7c80668840d997.title: Judicial Case Management Administrator
9e385b7c80668840d997.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

Family Court’s mission is to provide equal access to justice for the families and children under its jurisdiction in a manner that is fair and efficient and that maintains the public’s trust and confidence in an independent and accountable judiciary.

  

We strive each day to build an atmosphere that ensures all members of the public are treated with courtesy, dignity, and respect. We strive to have the same environment for our staff and value a diverse workforce.

  

We offer career opportunities that make a difference in people’s lives every day. Come join our team where our goal is to operate Family Court through great staff across the state.

  

Please note: FREE parking is available in New Castle County for Family Court staff.

**Summary Statement**
---------------------

This position (Judicial Case Management Administrator, working title “Family Court Director of Child Support) has statewide responsibility and reports to a member of administrative management. Statewide travel is a requirement of this position. An incumbent in this class is responsible for directing all child support related activities within Family Court. This involves very detailed budgetary responsibilities as they relate to Title IV-D federal funding, including assuring proper accounting and use of federal IV-D reimbursements. This incumbent is a key member of the Child Support Guideline Review/Quadrennial Review of the Delaware Child Support Formula as required by federal regulations. This incumbent is the Court’s liaison to the Division of Child Support Services (DCSS) and the Delaware Department of Justice (DOJ) Child Support Unit and leads initiatives to further child support services offered within Delaware. Policy and procedure development, and review related to child support filings and workflow are also primary responsibilities. This position acts as the primary trainer for all child support topics for Family Court staff and Judicial Officers.

  

This is the administrative level within the Judicial Case Management series. This level is distinguished from other levels by performing broader and more complex work encompassing all court case management operations. Work includes participation in the planning and development of administrative policies and procedures. Additionally, an employee oversees process improvement initiatives and provides planning and oversight in the Courts training and new employee development activities. Statewide travel is a requirement of this position. This employee:

  
  

* Receives general direction and guidance from an administrative supervisor or higher in terms of broad goals and objectives; plans and establishes the methods for achieving goals and objectives and administers case management operations.
* Administers case management operations for an assigned court which includes planning, coordinating, implementing, and evaluating operations, services, processes, procedures, and quality.
* Provides daily expertise, recommendations, and strategic direction to leadership and other high-level officials on complex challenges and is responsible for communications and change management.
* + Works with Fiscal Department on management of federal IV-D funding and reimbursements.
  + Works with Staff Attorney on legislative efforts involving child support matters.
  + Trains staff and judicial officers on all aspects of child support including filing information, case flow procedures, calculations, and child support law.
  + Supports the Chief Judge in leading Quadrennial Review activities.
* Oversees and participates in the development and implementation of programs designed to expedite work/case flow on a court-wide basis.
* Assists judicial officers, attorneys, and court staff by coordinating and maintaining daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly calendars of court events and performs specialized program support work. This information is compiled from multiple sources and depends on the accurate coordination of many stakeholders.
* Serves as the highest point of contact and expert on handling sensitive or escalated case management issues with both internal and external contacts and members of the public.

  

**Preferred Qualification**
---------------------------

One year of experience in researching and analyzing legislation to understand its impact that includes drafting memos and briefing materials for administrative management and detailed written and verbal communication to a broad audience.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

Essential functions are fundamental, core functions common to all positions in the class series and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties for any one position in the class. Since class specifications are descriptive and not restrictive, employees can complete job duties of a similar kind not specifically listed here.

  

* Assesses case filings to determine placement in case track/program or recommends referral to alternative case tracks.
  
  
* Serves as a liaison with internal and external stakeholders, judicial officers, court users, justice partners, and members of the public to coordinate various activities, respond to inquiries, and explain court case processes and procedures.
  
  
* Creates and maintains case files ensuring that the files are accurate and complete.
  
  
* Monitors and coordinates case activity through multiple legal events and processes, tracks case events/status, anticipates case flow problems and causes for delay, and initiates appropriate action to expedite cases effectively and efficiently including contacting participants to resolve issues that inhibit case flow.
  
  
* Researches case files, records, and other sources of information, and coordinates with internal/external resources, to ensure accuracy of case data, resolve issues or complaints, and prepare and issue court documents.
  
  
* Coordinates case activity and events with judicial officers, attorneys, law enforcement agencies, and litigants.
  
  
* Advises judicial officers regarding various case events that ultimately lead to final case disposition.
  
  
* Establishes and maintains contacts with the legal community, other agencies and courts/units, both internally and externally, to ensure case flow is expedited.
  
  
* Attends court proceedings which may include annotating on court worksheets, creating automated sentence orders, facilitating data entry, swearing in witnesses, and marking evidence.
  
  
* Uses automated information systems and computer software to enter, update, modify, delete, retrieve and report on data.
  
  
* Arranges delivery for legal paperwork and/or other correspondence.
  
  
* May manage court calendars or other schedules including duties such as scheduling within guidelines, coordinating parties, rescheduling, and generating notices.
  
  
* Performs other related duties as required.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

**Job Requirements for Judicial Case Management Administrator (Director of Child Support)**

Applicants must have education, training, and/or experience demonstrating competence in each of the following areas:

  

1. Three years’ experience in legal case flow management.

2. One year of experience in interpreting laws, rules, regulations, standards, policies, and procedures.

3. One year of experience in directing or overseeing operations or in staff supervision, which may include planning, assigning, reviewing, and evaluating the relevant work within the system.

4. Six months’ experience developing and implementing policies, procedures, action plans, and process improvement initiatives.

5. Six months’ experience managing administrative and operational resources, including budget development and monitoring, using automated information systems, and demonstrating strong written and verbal communication skills in support of organizational objectives.

  

**Conditions of Hire**
----------------------

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

  

This position is a classification organized under an exclusive bargaining representative (labor organization) that has been elected by employees as their representative for collective bargaining and other applicable terms and conditions of employment, in accordance with Title 29, Chapter 59 and Title 19, Chapter 13 and 16. This position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement based on its individual terms.

  

Criminal background check: A satisfactory criminal background check is required as a condition of hire. The recruiting agency may require the applicant to pay for the criminal background check as part of the conditional offer of hire.

**Benefits**
------------

To learn more about the comprehensive benefit package please visit our website at https://dhr.delaware.gov/benefits/

**Selection Process**
---------------------

The application and supplemental questionnaire are evaluated based upon a rating of your education, training and experience as they relate to the job requirements of the position. It is essential that you provide complete and accurate information on your application and the supplemental questionnaire to include dates of employment, job title and job duties. For education and training, list name of educational provider, training course titles and summary of course content. Narrative information supplied in response to the questions must be supported by the information supplied on the application including your employment, education and training history as it relates to the job requirements.

  

Once you have submitted your application on-line, all future correspondence related to your application will be sent via email. Please keep your contact information current. You may also view all correspondence sent to you by the State of Delaware in the “My Applications” tab at StateJobs.Delaware.gov.

**Accommodations**
------------------

Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an auxiliary aid or service please call (302) 739-5458. TDD users should call the Delaware Relay Service Number 1-800-232-5460 for assistance.

  

The State of Delaware is an Equal Opportunity employer and values a diverse workforce. We strongly encourage and seek out a workforce representative of Delaware including race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

2a51f769f7c32bdb15de.description:
Part-Time or Full-Time Office Administrator

General Contracting & Residential Remodeling Company

Location: Long Island, NY

Job Description

Role: **Business Development Representative -** entry level sales role

Contract Type: **Full-time, Permanent**

Location: **Remote** **-** **Central USA: ideal locations will be Chicago, Illinois or Houston - this position will be working remotely (so home based, but ideally in one of these locations)**

Salary: **$60,000 - $75,000 per annum, plus Excellent Commission Scheme and benefits including: health, vision/dental insurance; disability, vacation, sickness, 401K**

Hours: **Monday – Friday – (40 hours per week)**

Kinly is a unified global leader in collaboration, systems integration, and managed services. We focus on transforming workspaces, simplifying complexity, and empowering people.

With comprehensive capabilities, decades of experience, and expanded delivery teams, we empower global businesses to thrive in the hybrid world, and we are committed to driving a new era of inspiration and opportunity for our people, clients, and partners; one seamless experience at a time.

Exciting and brand new opportunity has arisen at Kinly and we want to recruit an energised sales-focused individual into our new Inside Sales team to help us develop our market presence even further.

Working as an Inside Sales/Business Development Representative you will play a key role in helping us grow, by working to achieve maximum sales profitability, growth, and account penetration within assigned accounts and with a strong focus on developing new business and logos.

The position is responsible and accountable for overall sales processes from initial contact and understanding client needs to the closure of the product/service delivery.

You will have responsibility for promoting, selling and securing orders from both existing and prospective customers.

This position reports directly to the Business Development Sales Manager who will provide direction and support and you will have the opportunity to work closely across various departments to identify, develop and deploy service offerings and lead strategic engagements with major customers.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Drive revenue through recognition and realisation of opportunities within accounts
* Work with customers and Kinly resources to leverage our products and services to enhance customers’ business and grow opportunities
* Help build the message to sell the full product and service portfolio of Kinly to other parts of customers’ business
* Contributes to the creation of stakeholder maps for accounts and determines and orchestrates a coverage plan
* Identify all customer contract renewals and build a plan for the renewal of those contracts
* Drive profitability and revenue growth year over year in assigned accounts
* Meet and exceed monthly and annual revenue goals by executing an account growth strategy
* Work with marketing to create Sales Programs centred on Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) endorsements
* Conduct regular business reviews and reporting with major accounts
* Manage relationships with manufacturers (OEMs), distributors, and resellers to further sales opportunities
* Provide input into pricing, positioning, and strategy within assigned verticals or markets.
* Research, prospect, and establish leads for corporate relationships followed by an introductory needs analysis/discovery meeting
* Prepare and present proposals to corporate decision-makers
* Generate new business revenue with special attention to net revenues

**Skills and experience:**

* Eager to develop a successful sales career
* Driven and self-motivated character with a passion for selling
* Capable of pursuing audio-visual, managed services, and voice integration business opportunities for Kinly within enterprise corporate spaces and other potential growth markets
* Capable of establishing strong working relationships both internally and externally
* Demonstrates excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Possesses strong presentation skills as an essential function of the position
* Comfortable managing relationships with executive-level contacts
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently
* Ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical buyers
