489748e10fda610cd7ab.title: Pharmacy Technician / Pharm Tech Apprenticeship
489748e10fda610cd7ab.description:
Our pharmacy technician positions have undergone an exciting transformation, moving from a transaction-based environment to a much more patient-centric one. As a Walgreens Pharmacy Technician or Pharmacy Technician Apprentice, you'll be front and center – interacting with our customers and developing strong patient relationships. Pharmacy is the core of our business, and our pharmacy technicians enjoy all the tools and support – including the latest technology – to grow their careers and reach their goals.
  
  
Walgreens is proud to invest & champion an “earn while you learn” Pharmacy Technician Training Program recognized by ASHP & Department of Labor. This apprenticeship program gives you an entry point to a career in health care by guiding you in taking steps towards becoming a Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) Certified Pharmacy Technician and helping you maintain the high level of skill required in the pharmacy care industry. Arming you with a nationally recognized, portable credential that will help you advance your career.
  
  
Whether you are new to working in pharmacies or are an experienced Pharmacy Technician Apply Now! Walgreens will train you to use your skills and talents to serve and care for our patients and customers. The courses, learning activities, and resources provided to you in our pharmacy technician training program are designed to give you foundational and advanced knowledge, skills, and on-the-job experiences you need to prepare to become a certified pharmacy technician.
  

* In accordance with state and federal regulations, assists the pharmacist, under direct supervision, in the practice of pharmacy. Assists the pharmacist in the performance of other Pharmacy Department duties in accordance with Company policies and procedures.
* Responsible for using pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions. If PTCB certified, assists with and coaches pharmacy technicians in the operation of pharmacy systems and cashiers in the operation of the pharmacy cash registers.
* Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.

**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
* Develops strong relationships with most valuable customers.

  
**Operations**

* Under the supervision by the pharmacist, assist in the practice of pharmacy, in accordance with state, federal, and company policy. Reviews and complies with the Walgreen Co. Pharmacy Code of Conduct.
* Performs duties as assigned by Pharmacy Manager, Staff Pharmacist and Store Manager including utilizing pharmacy systems to enter patient and drug information, ensuring information is entered correctly, filling prescriptions by retrieving, counting and pouring pharmaceutical drugs, verifying medicine is correct, and checking for possible interactions. Assists pharmacists in scheduling and maintaining work flow.
* Reports, immediately, prescription errors to pharmacist on duty and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Quality Improvement Program.
* Strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription dispensing activities.
* Responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned cash register, collects and handles cash as required. Takes customer to OTC aisle when possible to assist in locating products.
* Handles telephone calls that do not require personal attention of the pharmacist, including those to physicians.
* Processes (corrects and resubmits) manual claims for third party program prescription services in a timely and efficient manner, and performs other clerical duties, as assigned by the Pharmacy Manager.
* Assists and supports Pharmacy Department on inventory management activities, such as, ordering, unpacking, checking and storing shipment of pharmaceuticals. Maintains knowledge of Company asset protection techniques, and files claims for warehouse overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods involving Rx drugs.
* May assist pharmacist in administering clinical services including the collection and proper labeling of blood/urine samples from patients and other clinical services as required; assists pharmacy staff in coordination of clinical services, Walgreens healthcare clinics and external providers.
* Assists Pharmacy Manager and Staff Pharmacist in developing and maintaining good relationships with the local medical community, including physicians, nurses, and other health care providers, by medical provider detailing and outreach to health groups, retirement homes, nursing homes, and other forums for enhancing growth opportunities.
* Assists with exterior and interior maintenance by ensuring the Pharmacy Department is stocked with adequate supplies, clean, neat and orderly in condition and appearance.
* Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
* Completes special assignments and other tasks as assigned.

  
**Training & Personal Development**

* Earns and maintains PTCB certification through the designated PTCB training program and/or state required certification/registration. Otherwise, earns PTCB certification as condition of promotion to senior technician.
* Attends training requested by Manager and acquires continuing education credits. Maintains knowledge and skill in healthcare and pharmacy, including latest news and developments.
  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
  

* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)
* Requires willingness to work flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours.
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Prefer six months of experience in a retail environment.
* Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens.
* Prefer good math skills so they can fill prescriptions accurately, including counting, measuring and weighing medications.
* Prefer good computer skills.
* Prefer the knowledge of store inventory control.
* Prefer PTCB certification.

We will consider employment of qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
An Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans.
  
  
The actual compensation that you will be offered will depend on a variety of factors including geography, skills and abilities, education, experience and other relevant factors. This role will remain open until filled. To review benefits, please click here jobs.walgreens.com/benefits. If you are applying on a job board or unable to click on the link, please copy and paste this URL into your browser jobs.walgreens.com/benefits

------------

* ### **Prescription coverage**

9aa4be1ae7d528dbf7ad.title: Quality Manager Senior
9aa4be1ae7d528dbf7ad.description:
For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 11,000 employees worldwide, our Climate Solutions and Performance Technologies segments advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit modine.com.

**Position Description**
------------------------

At Modine, we are Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™. For more than 100 years, Modine has delivered innovative thermal management solutions that power critical industries worldwide. As demand for high-performance cooling solutions continues to accelerate, successful product development and launch execution are essential to ensuring customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and long-term product reliabiliy.

The Senior Quality Manager - New Product Introduction (NPI) is responsible for leading all quality planning and quality engineering activities associated with new product development and launch programs. This position serves as the primary Quality representative within cross-functional product development teams and is accountable for ensuring quality requirements, risks, and deliverables are effectively managed throughout Modine's stage-gate product development process.

The role provides independent assessment of product, process, supplier, and manufacturing readiness while ensuring quality considerations are appropriately represented during development reviews and launch decision-making. Through proactive risk identification, structured quality planning, and cross-functional collaboration, the Senior Quality Manager helps ensure products are launched on time, with robust manufacturing processes, capable suppliers, and exceptional customer quality performance

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**NPI Quality Leadership & Stage-Gate Governance**

* Serve as the primary quality representative for assigned New Product Introduction programs.
* Lead all quality planning and quality engineering deliverables throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Ensure completion of required quality activities and deliverables at each stage-gate milestone.
* Assess product, process, supplier, and customer quality risks and communicate readiness status during gate reviews.
* Provide independent quality recommendations regarding progression through development and launch phases.
* Drive accountability and closure of quality-related open items prior to launch approval.

**Design Quality & Risk Management**

* Participate as an embedded member of product development teams, representing the voice of quality throughout design and development activities.
* Facilitate Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), Design Risk Reviews, Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) development, and Design for Quality (DFQ) activities.
* Ensure historical quality lessons learned, warranty data, and field performance feedback are incorporated into product designs.
* Partner with Engineering to identify and mitigate design risks early in development.
* Support development and execution of Design Verification Plans and Reports (DVP&R) and validation strategies.

**Manufacturing Readiness & Process Quality**

* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Plant Quality teams to ensure production processes are capable and launch-ready.
* Lead or facilitate Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and process validation activities.
* Ensure quality requirements are incorporated into manufacturing processes, inspection plans, and production documentation.
* Support manufacturing readiness reviews and launch preparedness assessments.
* Coordinate quality activities associated with prototype, pilot, and production builds.

**Prototype, Pilot & Launch Support**

* Provide hands-on quality support during engineering builds, prototype builds, pilot builds, and production launch activities.
* Monitor build quality performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Lead investigation of build issues, nonconformances, and launch-related concerns.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented and validated prior to production release.
* Support transition of products into normal production and operational ownership.

**Quality Metrics, Reporting & Readiness Reviews**

* Develop and maintain NPI quality scorecards and launch readiness metrics.
* Track quality risks, open issues, corrective actions, validation status, supplier readiness, and manufacturing readiness.
* Present quality status, recommendations, and risk assessments during program and leadership reviews.
* Provide clear visibility of launch risks and mitigation plans.

**Required Education & Qualifications**
---------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing Engineering, Program Management, or related technical disciplines.
* Minimum 5 years of experience supporting new product development, product launches, or quality planning activities.
* Strong knowledge of:
* DFMEA
* PFMEA
* APQP
* PPAP
* Control Plans
* Process Validation
* Root Cause Analysis
* Experience leading complex cross-functional projects and influencing teams without direct authority.
* Strong communication, facilitation, project management, and risk management skills.
* Demonstrated success supporting product launches in a manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in data center cooling, HVAC, refrigeration, thermal management, or complex electromechanical products.
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Manager (CMQ/OE), or similar certification.
* Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) certification.
* Experience operating within a formal stage-gate product development process.
* Experience launching products across multiple manufacturing locations.
* Knowledge of fabrication, welding, brazing, refrigeration systems, heat exchanger manufacturing, sheet metal fabrication, and final assembly operations.
* Experience supporting global product development and launch teams.

Modine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Modine provides a competitive benefit package, which could include paid vacation, short term disability, 401(k), health, dental, vision, life insurance, flex spending benefits, tuition reimbursement, Health Savings Account and much more. Human Resources will provide more detail upon your hiring.

The salary range for this position is estimated in good faith to be [minimum amount – maximum amount]. The specific offer will depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and other job-related considerations but will be within the stated range. Where required by applicable law, a general description of benefits and other compensation offered for this role is also provided or made available.

16a85e518cbb99ac048b.description:
**Job Title:**

Individual Sales & Growth Specialist

**The Company:**

Medality is a radiology education platform that helps radiologists build subspecialty expertise through on-demand learning. Medality is part of TrueLearn, an educational software company, focused on empowering healthcare institutions and individual learners to maximize performance on high-stakes licensure exams. Through its suite of learning tools, TrueLearn and its family of brands have prepared hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals in their pursuit of board certification, working closely with medical and health science institutions and residency programs across the United States. The company is growing rapidly and continues to innovate its platform and expand its portfolio of brands.

**The Role:**

TrueLearn is seeking a Growth and Sales Development Specialist with 3-5 years of experience in sales, business development, or growth marketing to drive individual (B2C) revenue across our education products, with a heavy focus on the Medality brand. This role turns marketing demand into closed sales by converting new leads, renewing and growing existing customers, and winning back lapsed ones.

This role is ideal for a consultative seller who enjoys building relationships with physicians and trainees and helping them find the right learning path for their career goals. The Growth and Sales Development Specialist will manage a high-volume pipeline of inbound and outbound opportunities, partnering closely with the Marketing and Sales teams to bring campaigns from launch through conversion.

The successful candidate will be comfortable juggling many conversations and priorities at once, writing personalized and persuasive outreach, staying organized and responsive, and spotting opportunities to improve conversion and retention.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* **Lead Conversion:** Convert inbound and high-intent leads into customers, responding promptly and matching each prospect to the right product for their career stage, subspecialty interests and goals.
* **Consultative Selling:** Serve as a product expert for prospective customers, answering detailed questions about curriculum, CME, certification and access to help them make confident purchase decisions.
* **Outbound Outreach:** Plan and execute targeted outbound campaigns to audience segments defined by business need, such as subspecialty focus areas, cohort launches and seasonal promotions.
* **Follow-Up + Pipeline Management:** Manage a high-volume B2C pipeline with a disciplined follow-up process, accurately tracking outreach, outcomes and commissionable sales.
* **Renewals + Retention:** Own B2C renewal outreach for expiring customers and win back lapsed customers to maximize retained revenue.
* **Account Growth:** Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and manage customer upgrades and account changes, including billing adjustments.
* **Sales Tools + Efficiency:** Use CRM, email and AI-assisted tools to scale personalized outreach while maintaining quality and accuracy.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Marketing on campaign timing, messaging and lead quality, and with Sales on account ownership and handoffs for group and institutional opportunities.
* **Customer Insights:** Share recurring objections, barriers to enrollment and customer feedback with Marketing to inform promotions and lifecycle strategy.

**The Skills Needed:**

* 3-5 years of experience in business development, customer success or growth marketing, preferably in EdTech, SaaS or healthcare
* Consultative selling approach, with the ability to understand a customer's goals and recommend the right solution rather than push a product
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to write warm, personalized and persuasive outreach at scale
* Comfort working with physicians and other healthcare professionals; familiarity with medical education or radiology is a plus
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage a high-volume pipeline and keep every conversation moving
* Belief that the best selling is human-led, backed by hands-on experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to streamline research, outreach and workflow
* Experience with CRM, email and e-commerce tools, and comfort learning new systems quickly
* Comfort with numbers, including pricing, discounts, prorated billing and tracking your own results against goals
* Excellent collaborator and proactive communicator who works well with Marketing and Sales
* Positive, action-oriented attitude and professional demeanor
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment

**The Perks**

* Highly competitive benefits, including medical, dental and vision
* Additional benefits for employees to opt into
* Retirement: 401(k) with match
* Self-regulated PTO
* Monthly commission on B2C sales
* A diverse, challenging and fun work environment
* Fully remote workforce: work from the comfort of your home!
* The ability to influence how we work and directly impact revenue and the customer experience

**Compensation:**

* Base salary: $68,500
* Commission: 1.5% of sales sourced or influenced
* Annual bonus: eligible for up to 5% of base salary, based on company performance against goals
* On-target earnings (OTE): approximately $100,000

Pay: $68,500.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Disability insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Work from home

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Work Location: Remote

### ***St. Luke's is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke's are our most valuable asset! Individually and together, our employees are dedicated to satisfying the mission*** ***of our organization which is an unwavering commitment to excellence as we care for the sick and injured; educate physicians, nurses and other health care providers; and improve access to care in the communities we serve, regardless of a patient's ability to pay for health care.***

* Achieves expected practice financial performance through judicious expense management, efficient resource utilization, volume growth, and execution of expected financial management best practices.
* Utilizes organizational tools to monitor practice performance (volume, patient satisfaction, productivity, quality, etc.), identifies opportunities for improvement, and develops/implements improvement strategies via a multidisciplinary, team-based approach.
* As applicable, effectively utilizes practice leads (e.g., Practice Operations Coordinators, Clinical Coordinators, etc.) to support oversight of practice workflows/processes, etc.

* Other duties as assigned.

Sitting for up to three (3) hours per day; three (3) hours a t a time. Standing for up to eight (8) hours per day; eight (8) hours at a time. Walking for up to six (6) hours per day; one (1) hour at a time. Frequent fingering, handling, grasping, twisting, and turning as it relates to therapeutic procedures. Consistently lift, carry, and push objects up to 10 pounds. Occasionally lift, carry, and push objects up to 75 pounds. Rarely lifting with assistance, up to 100 pounds. Rarely pushing and pulling patients weighing up to 300 pounds in a wheel chair or stretcher. Occasionally stooping and bending. Must be able to perceive attributes of an object through touch. Seeing as it relates to normal near, far, color, and peripheral vision. Hearing as it relates to normal conversation and high and low frequencies.

**EDUCATION:**

Bachelor’s Degree in health, business, or related field preferred

**TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Minimum of 2+ years of medical office or practice operations experience, including at least 1 year in a healthcare setting
* Experience managing or supporting daily operations such as staffing coordination, scheduling, patient access, workflow management, and regulatory compliance
* Demonstrated ability to supervise staff, support performance management, and maintain service and quality standards

Competencies required for this job:

* Strong business acumen
* Skilled in all forms of communication
* Effectively able to develop self and others
* Leadership presence/EQ, presents as a composed and competent leader
* Quality focused
* Exudes patient and customer service focus
* Shares a compelling strategy that inspires others

*Please complete your application using your full legal name and current home address. Be sure* *to include employment* *history for the past seven (7) years, including your present employer. Additionally, you are encouraged to upload a current resume, including all work history, education, and/or certifications and licenses, if applicable. It is highly recommended that you create a profile at the conclusion of submitting your first application. Thank you for your interest in St. Luke's!!*

21b8d84b8e01658cf649.description:
**Job Title: ITAF Practice Coordinator Reports to:** [Operation Director / Executive Director]  
**Location:**  
**Employment Type:** Part-time 20-30 hours

**Position Summary:** The **Practice Coordinator** is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the It Takes A Family practice office in Pennsville, NJ. The qualified person will ensure efficient workflow, quality patient care, and compliance with organizational policies and procedures, while also serving as the key point of contact between clinical and administrative staff, supporting smooth coordination across all aspects of the practice, including scheduling, patient flow, documentation, authorizations, customer service, hiring, outreach, practice growth, and development. This role should also ensure that all services are delivered with the highest standards of quality, compliance, and efficiency while maintaining a strong focus on client outcomes, staff performance, and location growth.

**Key Responsibilities: Operational Oversight**

* Coordinate and supervise daily administrative operations to ensure efficient, patient-centered experience.
* Maintain effective communication between front desk staff, clinicians, and management.
* Provide leadership and direction for all clinic operations, including clinical services, administration, and support departments.
* Develop and implement operational strategies that align with the organization’s mission, values, and long-term goals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement among all staff.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for leadership at the Cinnaminson office.
* Collaborate with Clinicians and administrative staff to ensure staff meet documentation, scheduling, and productivity standards.
* Monitor client flow, caseload distribution, and appointment utilization to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Payroll oversight

**Staff Supervision and Support**

* Provide guidance and day-to-day supervision for front desk staff, including training, task management, and performance support.
* Promote teamwork and accountability across the site.
* Conduct regular check-ins with staff to review performance and address any operational or workflow challenges.
* Ability to engage in difficult conversations with clarity and respect while maintaining a supportive, solution-focused approach.

**Compliance and Reporting**

* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, organizational policies, and payer requirements.
* Monitor and review appointment and billing reports to identify discrepancies or missing data.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure that all documentation and reports are submitted on schedule.

**Collaboration and Communication**

* Work closely with clinical leadership and management to support program goals and site operations.
* Communicate updates, procedural changes, and expectations to all team members clearly and promptly.
* Participate in meetings, training sessions, and quality improvement initiatives as required.
* Proactively identifies tasks, follows through to completion, and resolves issues without requiring repeated direction or reminders

**Data, Reporting, and Evaluation**

* Monitor key result areas (KRAs) such as client retention, productivity, authorization turnaround, and service outcomes.
* Prepare and present operational and clinical performance reports to executive leadership.

**Compliance, Quality, and Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, including HIPAA, Joint Commission, and payer requirements.
* Oversee internal audits and corrective action plans related to clinical documentation, billing, and operational compliance.
* Implement and monitor quality assurance and performance improvement initiatives.
* Ensure the clinic maintains accreditation and licensure requirements.

**Client and Community Relations**

* Ensure client satisfaction through high-quality, client-centered services and responsive communication.
* Build and maintain relationships with referral sources, community partners, and stakeholders.
* Represent the clinic at community meetings, networking events, and public forums.
* Promote outreach initiatives that support community engagement and access to care.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Health Administration, Business, or a related field preferred.
* **Experience:** Minimum of **2–3 years of experience** in a medical office, or management position, at least **1 year of supervisory or lead experience** required.
* **Skills:**
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

ebfe28c2ad62e7d59c0e.title: Executive Assistant & Insurance Operations Coordinator
ebfe28c2ad62e7d59c0e.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Location: Pennsauken / Westville, New Jersey

Experience Required: 3–5 years in the insurance industry

Crespo Insurance Agency, LLC is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to work directly with the Agency Owner and support the daily operations and continued growth of our insurance agency.

The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of insurance industry experience, excellent computer and spreadsheet skills, strong written communication abilities, and experience managing emails, CRM systems, and employee performance reports.

We are looking for someone who can anticipate needs, manage multiple priorities, maintain confidentiality, and ensure that important tasks are completed on time. This is an important position for someone who understands the insurance business and can help keep the Agency Owner and team organized, productive, and accountable.

This is not an entry-level administrative position. Insurance industry experience is required.

Salary Range: $40,000.00 - $55,000.00 per year

**Benefits**
------------

Annual Base Salary Based on Experience

Paid Time Off (PTO)  
Hands on Training  
Retirement Plan

**Requirements**
----------------

Qualifications

3–5 years of experience in the insurance industry.

Previous experience in an independent insurance agency is strongly preferred.

Strong knowledge of personal and commercial insurance operations.

Experience with email management, reporting, and administrative coordination.

Experience with CRM software and agency management systems.

Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines without constant supervision.

Professional judgment and discretion when handling confidential information

Reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Active Property & Casualty insurance license.

Experience with HawkSoft, AgencyZoom, or similar insurance software.

Previous experience supporting an agency owner, executive, or insurance office manager.

Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

What We Are Looking For

The successful candidate will be dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities. We need someone who does not simply wait for instructions but anticipates problems, follows through on assignments, and helps ensure that daily operations run smoothly.

The right person will be professional, organized, trustworthy, and committed to helping the agency improve productivity, accountability, and profitability.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

Opportunity for professional growth within an established insurance agency.

Collaborative work environment.

Opportunity to work directly with agency leadership and contribute to business growth

Specific compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume highlighting your insurance industry experience, Excel and reporting skills, payroll knowledge, and familiarity with CRM and insurance agency management systems.

Candidates with relevant insurance experience and strong organizational skills are encouraged to apply.

Crespo Insurance Agency, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

Executive & Administrative Support

Manage the Agency Owner's emails, correspondence, calendar, appointments, and daily priorities.

Review incoming emails, identify urgent matters, and prepare or send responses as appropriate.

Follow up with insurance carriers, employees, vendors, and business partners.

Maintain organized electronic records and confidential business documents.

Reporting & Spreadsheet Management

Create and maintain Excel and Google Sheets reports.

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly insurance production reports.

Track new business, renewals, premiums, commissions, and employee performance.

Monitor progress toward agency production goals and identify discrepancies.

Prepare reports that help management evaluate productivity and business growth.

Meetings & Employee Accountability

Prepare agendas and materials for daily morning meetings.

Record meeting minutes and distribute them to employees.

Track assignments, deadlines, and outstanding action items.

Follow up with team members to ensure commitments are completed.

Help monitor employee productivity and compliance with internal procedures.

Insurance Agency Operations

Understand personal and commercial insurance workflows, including quoting, binding, endorsements, renewals, and policy servicing.

Communicate with insurance carriers and assist with operational follow-ups.

Monitor CRM activity, lead follow-ups, pending quotes, and sales opportunities.

Help maintain accurate records in the agency management system.

Identify workflow improvements and assist with implementing efficient procedures.

Business Growth & Operation

Work closely with the Agency Owner to support business development and agency expansion.

Track production goals and employee performance metrics.

Assist with marketing initiatives, recruiting, onboarding, and training.

Help coordinate operations across the agency's Pennsauken and Westville locations.

f05765ff26c308f52018.title: Global Mobility Coordinator
f05765ff26c308f52018.description:
The **Global Mobility Coordinato**r supports employee mobilization, deployment, immigration, visa, travel, and workforce movement activities in support of domestic and international operations. This position works closely with employees, program leadership, Human Resources, Security, Medical Providers, Travel, and customer representatives to ensure personnel are prepared for assignment and meet applicable company, customer, and host nation requirements.

The Coordinator assists employees throughout the assignment lifecycle, including deployment preparation, travel coordination, documentation management, readiness tracking, and assignment support.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

The following duties are representative of the responsibilities associated with this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list.

* Coordinate employee mobilization, deployment, immigration, visa, travel, and assignment readiness activities for domestic and international assignments.
* Develop and maintain deployment schedules and workforce readiness tracking to support operational and staffing requirements.
* Coordinate and validate assignment documentation, including passports, visas, work permits, residency permits, Letters of Authorization (LOAs), Common Access Cards (CACs), medical requirements, country clearances, and customer-specific requirements.
* Monitor employee readiness and proactively identify missing documentation, expiring credentials, compliance concerns, or deployment obstacles.
* Coordinate travel arrangements and related logistics in support of employee deployments, international assignments, and business travel requirements.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for employees requiring assistance with mobilization, travel, immigration, deployment, and assignment-related requirements.
* Partner with Human Resources, Recruiting, Security, Contracts, Finance, Medical Providers, Travel, Program Management, customers, and external vendors to facilitate workforce mobility activities.
* Maintain mobility records, assignment tracking systems, reports, and workforce readiness data.
* Support audits, reporting requirements, compliance reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives related to mobility, travel, and deployment operations.
* Assist with the development and documentation of procedures, work instructions, and best practices supporting global mobility and travel operations.
* Perform other duties as assigned

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent and five (5) years of relevant experience; Associate degree and three (3) years of relevant experience; or Bachelor's degree and one (1) year of relevant experience.
* Relevant experience includes global mobility, deployment operations, immigration, visa processing, travel coordination, workforce mobilization, human resources, or related administrative functions.
* Experience supporting government contractors, overseas programs, international assignments, or Department of Defense deployment activities preferred.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:**

* Knowledge of global mobility, deployment, immigration, visa, travel, or workforce mobilization processes.
* Understanding of international travel documentation and country entry requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively with employees, managers, government representatives, and external vendors.
* Ability to analyze issues, identify solutions, and follow matters through resolution.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and business systems used to support mobility and travel operations.

**LICENSES & CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Valid driver's license may be required based on business needs.
* Passport eligibility and ability to obtain required travel documentation may be required.
* Relevant certifications in global mobility, immigration, project management, travel management, or human resources are desirable but not required.

**PHYISCAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Work is primarily performed in an office environment.
* Requires prolonged periods of sitting, working at a computer, and communicating by telephone, email, and video conferencing.
* May occasionally require lifting and carrying items up to 15 pounds.
* May require periodic domestic and international travel in support of business operations, employee mobilization activities, training, or customer requirements.
* May require occasional work outside normal business hours to support employees operating across multiple time zones and international locations.

**Security Clearance:**

* Ability to obtain a secret security clearance.

**Intrepid Acquisition Holdings, LLC**

**www.intrepidgs.com**

Intrepid Acquisition Holdings, LLC. (IAH), is a leading provider of global-scale logistics, facilities management, and advanced professional and technical services. 4125a2f3bb379eaa763b.title: Business Development Specialist (Administrative Support)
4125a2f3bb379eaa763b.description:
**Business Development Specialist**

**Who We Are**

Chelten House Products is a fourth-generation, family-owned private label food manufacturing company with facilities in Swedesboro, NJ. We are an industry leader widely recognized for our commitment to creating the finest-tasting pasta sauces, salad dressings, salsas, ketchups, and other sauces and blends.

**What We Have**

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package, including:

* Medical, vision, and dental benefits 1st of the month following startdate
* Company-wide perks and employee appreciation events
* Supplemental benefits including life insurance and 401(k) contributions
* Annual performance evaluations and target bonus incentives
* A diversified workforce committed to excellence and innovation
* Transparent and accessible leadership team
* A competitive pay range between $75,000 - $85,000 per year based on experience

**What We Are Looking For:**

A Business Development Specialist to support our Senior Business Development Manager. This role serves as the operational hub for key customer accounts, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to keep product development projects moving, support customer initiatives, and ensure seamless execution from concept through commercialization.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, strong communicator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys managing multiple priorities, and is naturally proactive. They will coordinate customer requests, track project milestones, analyze market and consumer trends, prepare reports and presentations, and proactively gather information across the organization to help keep our customers informed and our internal teams aligned.

This position offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to customer strategy, product innovation, and the commercialization of new food products while playing a critical role in the success of Chelten House's Business Development Team.

**What You Will Do:**

* Maintain business development dashboards, opportunity pipelines, and project trackers to ensure accurate, up-to-date visibility across all customer initiatives.
* Coordinate sample requests, shipments, and tracking to support customer meetings, product evaluations, and development timelines.
* Participate in product tastings, competitive evaluations, and sensory reviews to provide feedback that supports product development and customer innovation initiatives.
* Conduct competitive landscape reviews, product portfolio audits, and market research to identify trends and whitespace opportunities.
* Coordinate label specification and regulatory document requests with internal cross-functional teams.
* Manage new item setup documentation and customer submission requirements across retailer portals.
* Navigate retail customer portals to retrieve reports and submit required documentation.
* Serve as the primary liaison for internal project follow-up, proactively gathering updates from Product Development, Graphics, Regulatory, Purchasing, Operations, and Customer Service.
* Prepare customer meeting materials, presentations, and project summaries to support the Business Development Manager.
* Track action items, key milestones, and customer commitments to help ensure projects remain on schedule and tasks are executed.
* Proactively identify upcoming customer needs, outstanding action items, and potential risks to ensure the Business Development Manager is prepared for customer interactions and internal decision-making.

**What You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* 2-3 years of experience in project coordination, sales support, account management, customer service, or a related business function.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a high level of professionalism.
* Highly detail-oriented with the ability to maintain accuracy across multiple customer projects.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, ***particularly*** Excel and PowerPoint.
* Comfortable learning new software systems, customer portals, and internal databases.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* High level of adaptability, able to pivot responsibilities as needed to support business.
* Potential for travel with Business Development Team up to 25%.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting Business Development, Sales, Category Management, or Commercial teams in Retail or Manufacturing.
* Experience in food manufacturing, Consumer Product Goods, or private label.
* Familiarity with retailer portals, item setup processes, product development and/or product commercialization.
* Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders across Product Development, Operations, Purchasing, Graphics, Regulatory, and Customer Service.
* Natural Creative Vision for identifying areas of growth and developing strategic means to translate ideas into action.

b9f63096b5bbb0d8524f.title: Driver Operations Specialist
b9f63096b5bbb0d8524f.description:
Quality Carriers® is the leading bulk liquid chemical transportation provider in North America. With a fleet of over 2,500 trucks and 6,400 trailers, and a network of 100+ locations and 100+ years of experience, Quality Carriers provides industry leading transportation services to our customers.

We are looking for an energetic, reliable Driver Operations Specialist to join our team in Bridgeport, NJ. We are a dynamic, stable and growing company. We have great long term career opportunities across our headquarters, trucking terminals, mechanic shops, depots, tank washes and other locations. If you want to join the industry leader and make a difference, please consider this opportunity and apply at QualityCarriers.com.

**Compensation**

* Range between $65,000- $75,000

**Job Details**

**Job Summary:**

This position is the primary day-to-day contact for an assigned group of drivers (generally up to 30 drivers), consisting of company employee drivers and/or independent contractors. Drivers operate on a 24/7 basis; accordingly, the role is expected to participate in an on-call schedule. This schedule will vary based on location and business needs. This position handles a range of driver operation responsibilities, including but not limited to, dispatching, load planning and customer service.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

Driver Experience/Impact

* Know and facilitate each driver's individual compensation and time at home requirements.
* Maintain a driver calendar to be used to plan all drivers’ requested time off or unavailability including compliance related time the driver is not available to work.
* Record all driver home-time requests in TMW and other applicable systems.
* Discuss safety, compliance and service issues with drivers as needed. Facilitate documentation as required.
* Review performance bonus results with all company employee drivers quarterly, providing feedback to maximize bonus earnings.
* Perform a minimum of one driver ride along per quarter.

Safety Responsibility/Impact

* Actively engage drivers daily in safety conversation to help drive the QC Safety Culture.
* Ensure drivers' hours of service are properly updated in the ELD system.
* Work with Operations and Safety to issue breach of contract notices to independent contractors as required.
* Work with Operations, Safety and HR to develop disciplinary actions for company employee drivers consistent with company policy.
* Review system tools and data to provide relevant information to drivers regarding safety, customer service, regulatory and company policy compliance.
* Validate driver dispatch plans to ensure compliance with regulations and company policies.

Regulatory Responsibility/Impact

* Work with the Maintenance team on a daily basis to ensure all company equipment is in full compliance with all federal, state and local regulations.
* Ensure all monthly online safety training is completed and work with drivers and Safety to assign other training or refreshers as needed.
* Verify all tractor profiles are accurate including both presence and working condition of equipped accessories.

Service Delivery/Impact

* Individual customer contracts may exceed 95%.
* Properly pre-trip and communicate all assigned loads for assigned drivers to ensure a minimum of 95% on-time service is maintained.
* Verbally and electronically dispatch all drivers in accordance with company policies, utilizing company devices and software, such as ISAAC tablets, TMW, and TotalMail.
* Coordinate driver utilization with Central Scheduling and Equipment Planning teams to maximize driver earnings while ensuring customer service expectations are met.
* Communicate all potential and real service related issues proactively as they occur to ensure the customer is notified of all late deliveries prior to the planned arrival.
* Work with drivers on a daily basis for a smooth dispatch workflow process.

Planning

* Make the daily schedule and secure the necessary backhauls for all assets using all available inputs, to include, but not limited to, the driver calendar, available yard checks, available orders, and out-of-service reports from maintenance or driver reports.
* Work with surrounding terminals and central scheduling to maximize loaded miles on all assets.
* Manage the end-to-end tank wash process for all terminal-assigned equipment, including timely tank wash assignments, confirmation of prior product compatibility with the tank wash, scheduling, PO coordination, and ongoing communication with the tank wash on ETA to ensure timely completion.

Financial Responsibility/Impact

* Manage driver capacity priorities.

**Benefits:**

* Medical
* Dental/Vision
* Basic Life/Voluntary Life
* Short Term and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account
* Digital health through Recuro
* Employee Assistance Program
* 401k Employer Match and Roth Retirement Savings Plan
* Additional Voluntary Benefits

**Requirements**

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Experience with DOT Requirements, CSA expectations and Safety procedures.
* Ability to travel multiple times per year as needed for training and career development purposes.
* Highly proficient computer skills. Must be comfortable using a computer and various software programs.

**Education and Experience:**

* 4+ years truck transportation industry experience or 4-year degree preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in a leadership or management position.

**Additional Job Information**

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:**

* This is a full-time position, in office, 5 days a week.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Travel to various terminal locations.

**Company Information**

**Work Environment:**

* This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office and computer equipment.
* The worker is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions (such as in typical office or administrative work).

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* The employee will regularly and repetitively be required to talk, hear, sit, type, reach and grasp in a typical office environment.
* This position may require standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping or crouching. The employee must frequently lift and/or move items up to 20 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:**

Quality Carriers, Inc. provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

Equal Opportunity Employer  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

a82f7350f262282e751e.title: Store Operations Manager
a82f7350f262282e751e.description:
**Overall Job Summary**
-----------------------

The Store Operations Manager is responsible for leading operational execution in the store, with primary ownership of freight process execution and scheduling, Feed to Floor process execution, weekly recovery execution including Targeting Outs, backroom and dock standards, feed and food operational standards, security, and oversight of the Inventory Control Specialist role. This role is process-driven and promotes a safe, productive, compliant work environment while coaching Operations Team Members and supporting the Store Manager.

*Do you love the life out here and want to share it with others? At Tractor Supply we strive to make life out here a little bit better each day for both our neighbors and our teams.*

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities (Min 5%)**
--------------------------------------------------

It is essential that you be available, flexible, adaptable, and service-oriented, as you must be able to fulfill all of the following requirements:

* Maintain regular and predictable attendance.
* Work assigned schedules based on business needs.
* Uphold and promote a safe and productive work environment by following and enforcing policies and procedures.
* Deliver Legendary Service and reinforce Leading with Legendary behaviors through Customer engagement, Team Member coaching, and accountability for execution.
* Use A+ Coaching to celebrate and develop Team Members, improve selling behaviors, and reinforce consistent operating standards.
* Lead freight process execution and scheduling, including truck unload planning, freight movement, stocking execution, and follow-up to operational standards.
* Lead Feed to Floor process execution and ensure timely follow-up on assigned routines and process expectations.
* Lead weekly recovery process execution, including Targeting Outs, and ensure Store recovery standards are maintained.
* Oversee the Inventory Control Specialist role, including Inventory Control Specialist Weekly Checklist completion, coaching, development, follow-up, and accountability for receiving standards.
* Oversee inventory control and compliance processes completed by the Inventory Control Specialist, including inventory adjustments, discrepancies, negative on-hand review, PO processing, transfers, buybacks, RTV, and reconciliation routines.
* Maintain sidelot/FOD presentation, including signage, and ensure standards are executed consistently.
* Maintain backroom, dock, and assembly area standards, organization, and recovery.
* Maintain shelters, containers, feed centers, and related outside standards.
* Own damage feed/food markdown process execution and follow-up.
* Own the Styrofoam block process and pallet and wood crate process.
* Verify owners manuals are completed and maintained according to company standards.
* Own all store security processes and standards, including inside, outside, and high-dollar controls.
* Lead and coach assigned Operations Team Members; in applicable stores, manage direct reports and execute the Ops Team routine.
* Support Store Manager with store operations, planning, prioritization, delegation, safety, compliance, and financial results.
* Operate forklift, baler, cash register/computer, and other equipment as needed; assist customers with loading purchases.
* Complete all documentation associated with the above job duties accurately and timely.
* Obtain license or certifications as needed by the business.
* May be required to perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

*Experience:* Previous retail leadership experience is required. Prior store operations experience and supervisory experience is strongly preferred. Farming, ranching, pet/equine, or welding knowledge is preferred. Must be 18 years of age or older and possess a valid driver’s license.

*Education:* High school diploma or the equivalent is required. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or related field is preferred. Regardless of education level, you must be able to read, write, and count accurately.

**Preferred knowledge, skills or abilities**
--------------------------------------------

* Ability to perform and execute principle responsibilities of Team Members.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to resolve issues ethically and with minimal conflict.
* Excels in a fast paced work environment

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* Working environment is favorable, generally working inside with moderate noise.
* Indoor floors and outdoor lots generally are hard surfaces (concrete, asphalt, etc.) lighting and temperature are adequate.
* Ability to work outdoors in adverse weather conditions.
* Work shifts vary from one store to another, but generally are no less than 4 hours and may exceed 8 hours.
* Promote a safe and productive work environment for all Team Members, customers, and vendors, as well as train Team Members on the appropriate application of policies and procedures.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* This position is non-sedentary.
* It is essential that you have the physical and mental stamina and ability to move throughout the distribution center and outdoor areas quickly and safely.
* It is essential to operate all equipment related to their job duties efficiently, safely, properly and accurately; and to provide the highest level of customer service.
* Team members must have the physical and mental ability to perform all of the following tasks (with or without reasonable accommodation):
* Ability to move and transfer merchandise, weighing up to 50 pounds, throughout the store.
* Ability to push and pull merchandise up to 2,000 pounds with the assistance of proper material handling equipment (e.g. pallet jack).
* Ability to occasionally lift or reach merchandise overhead.
* Ability to frequently stand, kneel, twist, crouch, squat, bend, stoop, and climb ladders.
* Ability to move throughout the store for an entire shift.
* Ability to safely access all areas of the store including selling floor, side lot, stock area, and register area.
* Ability to operate and use all equipment necessary to run a store (e.g. dolly, hand truck, forklift, baler, computer, cash register).
* Ability to constantly operate store equipment such as computer, cash register, and other store equipment.
* Ability to read, write, and count accurately to complete all documentation.
* Ability to utilize strong written and verbal communication skills to communicate effectively with team members and customers.
* Ability to process information / merchandise through the point-of-sale system.
* Ability to successfully complete training and certification to dispense propane, and to dispense propane.
* Ability to successfully complete all required training.
* Ability to travel as required in support of district needs.
* Ability to drive or operate a vehicle for business needs.
* Ability to successfully complete training and certification for various business needs.

**Disclaimer**
--------------

*This job description represents an overview of the responsibilities for the above referenced position. It is not intended to represent a comprehensive list of responsibilities. A team member should perform all duties as assigned by his/ her supervisor.*

**Company Info**
----------------

At Tractor Supply and Petsense by Tractor Supply, our Team Members are the heart of our success. Their dedication, passion, and hard work drive everything we do, and we are committed to supporting them with a comprehensive and accessible total reward package. We understand the evolving needs of our Team Members and their families, and we strive to offer meaningful, competitive, and sustainable benefits that support their well-being today and in the future.
  
  
Our benefits extend beyond medical, dental, and vision coverage, including company-paid life and disability insurance, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement, and family planning resources such as adoption and surrogacy assistance, for all full-time Team Members and all part-time Team Members. Part time new hires gain eligibility for TSC Benefits by averaging at least 15 hours per week during their 90-day lookback period. The lookback period starts the first of the month following the date of hire. If the 15-hour requirement was met, the benefits eligibility date will be the first day of the month following 4 months of continuous service.

  

**Nearest Major Market:** New Jersey

  

**ALREADY A TEAM MEMBER?**
--------------------------

You must apply or refer a friend through our internal portal

**CONNECTION**
--------------

Our Mission and Values are more than just words on the wall - they’re the one constant in an ever-changing environment and the bedrock on which we build our culture. They're the core of who we are and the foundation of every decision we make. It’s not just what we do that sets us apart, but how we do it.

**EMPOWERMENT**
---------------

We believe in managing your time for business and personal success, which is why we empower our Team Members to lead balanced lives through our benefits and total rewards offerings. For full-time and eligible part-time TSC and Petsense Team Members. We care about what you care about!

**OPPORTUNITY**
---------------

A lot of care goes into providing legendary service at Tractor Supply Company, which is why our Team Members are our top priority. Want a career with a clear path for growth? Your Opportunity is Out Here at Tractor Supply and Petsense.

Mount Laurel, New Jersey, United States of America

40

$115,440 - $186,160 USD

* Knowledge of current and emerging competitor and market trends
* Ability to contribute to strategic direction of the function and provide advice to senior leadership
* Ability to forecast initiatives and demand in order to develop annual strategic plan
* Skilled in preparing and managing budgets and resource allocation

* Ability to make an impact, influence and achieve results with effective negotiation, problem-solving and communication skills
* Knowledge of risk management environment, standards and regulations

* Ability to exercise sound judgement in making decisions
* Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form
* Ability to work collaboratively and build relationships across teams and functions
* Skilled in using software tools, methods and techniques
* Skilled in using computer applications including MS Office
* Ability to analyze, organize and prioritize work while meeting multiple deadlines
* Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently

b6694ba3f305b368abe3.title: Transportation Coordinator
b6694ba3f305b368abe3.description:
**About Waga Energy**

Waga Energy was founded on a simple conviction: preserving the common good and helping build a sustainable future requires collective action.

Today, we are accelerating the energy transition by converting landfill gas into Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) through our proprietary WAGABOX technology. Operating across North America, South America, and Europe, we transform landfill emissions into clean, local renewable energy while helping reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

Our teams are united by three values, Boldness, Mastery, and Cooperation, and by a shared mission: maintaining a livable planet for future generations.

If you're looking for an opportunity to use your skills to make a measurable environmental impact, we'd love to hear from you.

**Transportation Coordinator**

**Bala Cynwyd, PA (Philadelphia Area)**

**Key Facts**

* 3+ years of experience in a logistics, freight, or transportation coordination role
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, or a related field
* Experience with US parcel and freight transportation regulations, safety requirements, and compliance standards
* Out-of-gauge transportation experience preferred

**About This Role**

As a Transportation Coordinator, you will manage domestic U.S. transportation for equipment, materials, and supplies supporting new and existing WAGABOX locations. Working across Supply Chain, Project, and Operations teams, you'll help ensure shipments arrive safely, on time, and at a competitive cost while maintaining visibility throughout the transportation lifecycle. Reporting to the U.S. Supply Chain Manager, this role will serve as a key operational link between internal teams, suppliers, freight forwarders, and logistics providers.

**What You'll Do - Responsibilities & Duties**

* Plan and coordinate domestic U.S. transportation for equipment, materials, and supplies supporting new and existing WAGABOX locations
* Partner with Supply Chain, Project, and Operations teams to support safe, timely, and cost-effective deliveries
* Obtain freight quotes and select logistics partners based on lead times, cost, service quality, and project requirements
* Review freight invoices to confirm alignment with contractual terms and approved quoted rates
* Anticipate transportation and delivery issues, develop mitigation plans, and expedite shipments when necessary
* Ensure shipments comply with applicable transportation regulations, company policies, and packaging requirements
* Maintain accurate shipment information, milestones, and documentation in transportation management systems for tracking, invoicing, reporting, and historical reference
* Act as the primary operational contact for internal stakeholders and logistics partners, providing proactive updates and resolving transportation issues promptly

**About You - Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, or a related field
* At least three years of experience in a comparable logistics or transportation role
* Knowledge of U.S. transportation regulations, freight safety requirements, and parcel and freight compliance standards
* Ability to evaluate transportation quotes and market rates and support effective provider selection
* Experience managing relationships with freight providers, suppliers, or other logistics partners
* Strong negotiation, critical-thinking, priority-management, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively across departments while independently managing multiple shipments and deadlines
* Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken, required

**Culture**

Faced with the urgent need to act to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, the employees of Waga Energy have committed themselves to take meaningful action to contribute to sustainable energy transition and the construction of a more environmentally friendly society. In serving as members of this committed team of professionals, Waga Energy employees are supported in meeting their professional development and career advancement goals within a fair, ethical culture focused on cooperation, humility, integrity, respect, and teamwork.

**Benefits**

Waga offers a competitive annual salary and benefits package including 20 days of paid time off, 11 paid holidays and paid parental leave along with health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance and a 401(k) plan with company matching contributions.

**Recruiting Process**

Waga Energy's recruiting process typically includes the following steps:

* Interview with human resources representation via phone or Teams.
* Candidate completes Predictive Index (PI) assessment.
* Interview with department manager via Teams.
* Interview with executive level manager via Teams or in person.

*Waga Energy is an equal opportunity employer.*

***Note to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies****: Waga Energy, Inc. is currently managing all recruiting efforts internally and is not accepting inquires or candidate recommendations from external agencies.*

* Back up the Facilities Manager in daily operations and assist with event setup and cleanup.

* Background supporting inventory control and material handling operations.

* Comfortably lift and move up to 50 pounds.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Warehouse Administrative Coordinator to join our dynamic logistics team. In this vital role, you will oversee daily warehouse operations, coordinate shipping and receiving activities, and ensure accurate inventory management. Your energetic approach will help streamline processes, enhance communication across departments, and support efficient order fulfillment. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced environment where your organizational skills and warehouse expertise will make a significant impact.

* Manage warehouse management system (WMS) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to track inventory levels, order processing, and shipping logistics.
* Coordinate shipping & receiving activities, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of goods.
* Oversee order picking & packing processes, utilizing RF scanners, pallet jacks, and order pickers to fulfill customer orders efficiently.

* Skilled in using RF scanners, pallet jacks, forklifts (certification preferred), and other warehouse equipment such as order pickers.
* Basic math skills for inventory counts, measurements, and data accuracy.
* Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail for data entry and stock management tasks.
* Knowledge of international trade regulations, trade compliance standards, and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) systems is a plus.

Join us as a Warehouse Administrative Coordinator to be at the heart of our supply chain operations! We’re committed to fostering a vibrant work environment where your skills grow alongside exciting career opportunities!

b1dc104ac9bafb88517f.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility.

As a **Vehicle Operations Specialist**, your primary responsibility is to manage all onsite vehicles including sales inventory, used vehicles, lease returns, and internal fleet in partnership with both on-site and HQ-based teams. The Vehicle Operations Specialist is a critical partner in ensuring the readiness of inventory, flow of vehicle movements, and accuracy of inventory tracking. We prioritize a world-class customer service experience, and our Vehicle Operations Specialist plays a key role in continuing to build upon the Lucid Motors brand through their organization and support of the sales team.

Our ideal candidate has an unwavering commitment to the accurate collection and recording of information and possesses demonstrable interpersonal and communication skills. You are meticulously detailed, well-organized, and understand the critical nature of setting daily priorities.

**The Role:**

* Monitor and manage the location's physical vehicle inventory, ensuring inventory vehicles are in ready-to-sell condition and that lots are clean and well organized
* Conduct lot walks and physical inventory to ensure inventory accuracy
* Partner with internal allocations team to inform of inventory needs
* Ensure inventory is well-maintained and appealing, performing software updates, cleaning and charging vehicles as required
* Partner with internal teams to manage lease return, trade-in and fleet vehicles on-site
* Coordinate logistics for vehicle movements as required between Lucid facilities and third-party locations
* Monitor inbound shipments of vehicles from manufacturing or third-party facilities
* Perform and verify vehicle intake inspection and ensure inbound cars comply with quality standards per Lucid's defined quality intake assessment
* Liaise with Service team in case of required repair work
* Partner with sales teams on the status of vehicle readiness
* Assist with new vehicle deliveries during high volume periods and daily operations as required

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of professional experience in operations or support role.
* Passion for a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Detail-oriented and focused on providing great experiences by improving efficiencies.
* Self-starter and quick thinker with high attention to detail who thrives in ambiguous and rapidly changing situations.
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills with the ability to relentlessly prioritize.
* Willingness to be hands-on with all vehicle operations.
* Ability to work evenings and weekends in a retail environment
* Valid driver's license with no suspensions within the past year. Drivers under 21 must have maintained a Driver's License for a minimum of 3 years and successfully complete Lucid Training upon hire
* Physical requirements include the ability to twist, bend, squat, reach, and stand for extended periods of time with or without reasonable accommodation

**Preferred:**

* Proficiency with Salesforce or other CRM.
* Prior experience in the automotive sector.
* A Bachelor's degree is preferred, or equivalent experience in business, marketing or related discipline

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Manage and grow a portfolio of referring physician accounts, serving as the main point of contact for client needs

* Strong relationship-management and communication skills
