7612cfb495c036d7ed9c.description:
Attention: Kapitus is aware that individuals posing as recruiters may be communicating with job seekers about supposed positions with Kapitus. Kapitus has received reports that the content and method of communication can vary, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive financial information.

Kapitus will **never** ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information during the initial application or interview process. All open positions are posted in location specific employment portals available at www.kapitus.com/careersAll legitimate Kapitus job postings on employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application through these portals before completion of the hiring process.

Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus' recruiting process in general should email **recruiting@kapitus.com**

The Partnerships Manager I is a key participant in the Channel Sales department responsible for acting as a liaison and managing the flow of small business applicants from our ISO partners to grow Kapitus' most important business partnerships. They will oversee all relationship management with their ISO partners and their book, strategize growth opportunities, and prospect for new accounts. They will also assist their Account Manager in the day-to-day deal flow, communicate daily with all partners in their sales pipeline, ensure they're followed up on and adjusted based on the need of the customer, and work through the entire sales process with partners until funding. Encompassing the full spectrum of relationship and account management.

**What you will do:**

* Manage partnership and all relationship matters from a higher level that includes partner onboarding and prospecting, strategize and implement new methods to grow accounts, and resolve reoccurring issues
* Converse effectively and efficiently with ISOs by maintaining an open line of communication while generating new business through pro-active targeted outbound calling and email
* Oversee negotiation, presentation, and business development while adhering to business compliance, credit, and legal policies / procedures at all times
* Maintain a strong awareness on key industry trends and become a subject matter expert when engaging with partners
* Create and execute a development plan for our partners through training, cadenced visits, and growth ideas
* Heavily utilize Tableau reports to assist ISOs in their own marketing campaigns and expected conversions
* Strategize and implement new methods to grow accounts and resolve reoccurring issues/escalations
* Recruit/build new relationships through phone calls, trade shows, emails and networking
* Seek out new initiatives to re-engage with inactive ISOs prior to account termination
* Develop and execute new opportunities to drive ISO and strategic partnership growth
* Provide partner coverage when any team member is out of office or on partner visits
* Understand the full application-to-fund life cycle, product, and our processes
* Use Salesforce and Platform to track activities and manage contacts
* Provide weekly commission, pipeline and analysis reports to ISOs
* Visit top 15 accounts one to two times per year
* Attend industry related conferences two to three times per year
* Responsible for pipeline engagement and any syndication deals
* Manage Credit Committee exceptions when available
* Compile/share competitive offers and intel from ISOs
* Other tasks as required by management

**Individual and Team Development Responsibilities:**

* Inspire and create a motivating environment through coaching, mentoring, and enablement
* Provide opportunities to participate in both formal and informal developmental activities
* Working with senior leaders and department head, set expectations for all team members and hold employees accountable for results
* Lead hiring, performance management, compensation, and evaluation of team members
* Collaborate with Kapitus leadership and HR to continually refine and modify career growth and succession plans to meet changing business needs

**What we are looking for:**

* Bachelor's degree and/or comparable experience preferred
* 3+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in Payment Processing, Financial Services, and/or Consultative Sales with a history of success
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
* Excellent analytical, presentation, and phone skills
* Experience with contract/partnership negotiations is a plus
* Proven success in meeting and exceeding sales goals
* Communicate decisions effectively in both verbal and written communication
* Team player with a strong sense of accountability
* Experience achieving metric and quality performance
* Self-starter with ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent negotiation and business development skills.
* Extensive industry knowledge on pricing, equipment, and/or gateways.
* Efficient planning, organization and time management skills.
* Goal oriented leader with a proactive approach in developing relationships with merchants and ISO partners.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook and CRM.
* Smart, hard-working individual who wants to be an integral part of an enterprise sales team
* Effective at communicating clearly
* Experience with administrative tasks
* Strong professionalism and adaptability

**Kapitus Total Rewards Package Includes:**

* **Competitive Base Salary** of $115,000. Kapitus is providing this as a good faith salary range to comply with applicable law. The applicant's final salary will depend on a number of factors including the applicant's geographic location, skills, and experience
* **Incentive Commission Compensation Plan –**earned monthly

* **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and employer-paid vision plans through UnitedHealthcare (UHC), with various coverage levels available to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life.
* **Flexible Spending Account:** Set aside pre-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out-of-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses.
* **Lifestyle Spending Account:** Employer sponsored post-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well-being.
* **100% Company Paid Insurances:** Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense.
* **Voluntary Insurance:** Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short- and long-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events.
* **Paid Maternity and Parental Leave:** Beyond state-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones.
* **Commuter Benefits:** We offer pre-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work.
* **LifeBalance Program:** Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include:
  + Pet and car insurance discounts.
  + Financial services such as LegalShield.
  + Relaxation and stress management tools.
* **Plum Benefits Discount Program:** Access exclusive discounts on shows, travel, car rentals, and more, enriching your personal and family life.
* **Tuition Reimbursement:** Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy.
* **Travel Reimbursement:** We also offer travel reimbursement for all work-related travel, supporting your involvement in career and personal development activities.
* **Paid Time Off and Sick Time.**
* **Retirement Benefits**: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary.

  

**About Kapitus:**

Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. We have spent our entire existence building a culture that makes us excited to come to work in the morning. Our company is fast paced, teammates need to be self-directed and have an internal motivation to do the right thing, even when the right thing takes a lot of hard work. We show our teammates our appreciation by offering great benefits, competitive pay and solid opportunity for growth.

**Company Mission:** At Kapitus, our mission is to help small business owners grow their organizations by providing tailored, transparent, and ethical financing solutions. We invest in every business owner's story and we are dedicated to building lasting relationships to champion their goals. We promise to keep the best interests of our clients at the center of the financing process by operating with transparency, fairness, and integrity.

643454ce5e30d10b5842.title: Director, Relationship Management - ABLE
643454ce5e30d10b5842.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**  
The Director, Relationship Management will join the growing Relationship Management team focused on state ABLE programs powered by Vestwell Government Savings. You will serve as a senior relationship manager on the ABLE team and will provide primary support for ABLE team operations and service.

**What Will You Be Doing?**  
Servicing individual ABLE state clients and overseeing core aspects of the team's project management, client interaction, service, and satisfaction. You will also be responsible for reviewing, auditing, and updating team processes to ensure efficiency and quality, and will provide primary support to the SVP of ABLE Programs on all matters of ABLE program administration.

Day-to-Day, You May Be Expected To:

**State Client Engagement**:

* Relationship management and existing state client engagement
* + Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for state directors (and staff) of ABLE investment programs nationwide, servicing general program administration, giving updates, intaking project requests, resolving issues, and more
  + Participating in regular weekly / bi-weekly client meetings throughout launch/conversion/ongoing Plan administration
  + Preparing materials, presentations, project trackers, and other work documents for state clients
  + Presenting at board meetings or other public meetings (in-person and remotely)
  + Gathering data and answering program-specific questions for clients
  + Handling escalations of customer service issues with support from Vestwell service teams; reporting resolutions to clients
  + Working with other cross-functional Vestwell teams (including product, engineering, legal, marketing) to triage client requests to the appropriate people and ensure accurate, efficient resolution
* Engaging with new/potential state client partners
* + Tracking and reporting on state activity and new program opportunities
  + Maintaining relationships with Treasurers' / State Government staff and continuing to serve as a subject matter expert

**Project Management / Processes**

* Implementing project management systems and processes across the entire ABLE Relationship Management team
* Working with VGS operations and client services teams to ensure efficient processes and QC oversight for all ABLE administration
* Oversee project management by other team members
* Tracking client projects from intake to completion, in a timely manner
* Clearly communicating project status and timelines to clients
* Ensure client satisfaction with project tracking and completion

**Program Materials, Communications, and Documentation**

* Review (and, as needed, draft) public-facing Program documents, including Program forms, marketing collateral, emails, website copy, etc.
* Ensure accuracy and all public-facing ABLE program materials
* Work with the internal team and subservice organizations or partners on all aspects of ABLE program design and implementation

**Public Engagement/Industry Efforts**:

* Present at or attend conferences, public meetings, and public events to represent Vestwell and its ABLE programs
* Serve on ABLE industry committees and working groups (e.g., within the ABLE Savings Plans Network, under the National Association of State Treasurers)
* Assist with the development of materials/content for Vestwell leadership team
* Develop relationships and engage with other partner organizations and stakeholders within the ABLE and disability advocate communities

  

**Requirements**  
The Necessities

The ideal candidate will have experience in creating portfolio marketing strategies with strong customer experience, engagement ideation and digital acumen. This experienced marketing professional will be responsible for the development, refinement, and overall execution of the US commercial strategy for the HCPs and HCCs across the US Oncology Portfolio within key assets – websites and digital interactive field sales resources.
  
  
The position can be Hybrid or Remote, given the candidates experience, and may also be based in either Philadelphia, PA or Upper Gwynedd, PA reporting to an Executive Director, Portfolio Strategy – US Oncology
  
  
This position will require outstanding leadership and collaboration in many areas including strategy development, people management, digital acumen, digital analytics, market research, relationship building, heavy prioritization, budget management and overall flawless launch execution. Candidates will require the ability to deliver the business today, while simultaneously planning for future indications with a proven track record to work successfully under tight and often fluctuating timelines.

Job Description
  
  
The Associate Director, Oncology Key Accounts is the main point of contact for our Company with large Oncology group practices and integrated delivery networks that have a focus on Oncology and Hematology. This is a crucial role in establishing our Company as an industry leader, supporting healthcare partners and providers, improving patient health outcomes, and becoming a trusted resource.
  
  
This is a field-based key account management position that has responsibility for accounts in the Philadelphia / New Jersey geography. The candidate should live within the geography.
  
  
Primary Activities & Responsibilities include and may not be limited to the following:
  
  
**Leadership:**  

* Builds and maintains trust with colleagues, stakeholders, and customers through effective communication, integration, and collaboration.
* Ability to lead through challenging and ambiguous situations while ensuring that deadlines and objectives are met, by effectively prioritizing tasks based on urgency, impact, and resource availability.
* Ability to influence others and lead without authority during complex situations, fostering collaborative problem-solving and reaching consensus. Experience in navigating varied teams or stakeholders to achieve common goals.

**Clinical Proficiency:**  

* Understands applicable product portfolio to provide approved disease and product information to key decision makers and stakeholders within account(s).
* Leads our Company's efforts to maximize appropriate utilization of its portfolio while bringing resources to customers that contribute to better outcomes for patients.
* Understanding of external quality initiatives with the ability to clearly align and tailor response to customer’s needs using approved Company resources and messages.
* Understand all aspects of treatment decision factors, including but not limited to knowledge of pathways, protocols, sites of care, guidelines or quality initiatives.

**Business Acumen:**  

* Utilizes internal data and data analytics to understand account performance and identify opportunities for appropriate engagement.
* Knowledge of account ecosystem and current emerging market and business trends impacting assigned accounts. Develop and pull-through a coordinated and longitudinal account plan.
* A deep understanding of the unique dynamics of the business to business (B2B) market, including the various factors that influence buying decisions, such as competitive landscape, industry trends, and economic conditions. Ability to utilize approved messages and resources with appropriate healthcare business partners (HBPs) across the account.
* Coordinate across a network of local account teams to ensure contract pull-through and address local requests for contract terms or conditions.

**Operational/Account Management:**  

* Establishes strategic approach to the account in alignment with approved guidance from the marketing teams. Aligns brand strategy and tactics with customer needs and business objectives to improve patient health outcomes.
* Builds trust and relationships with key decision makers and stakeholders and influencers to understand their objectives, goals, and challenges. Identifies approved resources that align with the customer’s needs. Develops a thorough understanding of all entry access points and knowledge of stakeholders who influence and operationalize access for the entire enterprise.
* Uses approved tools to capture, share and appropriately communicate internally about the customer.

**Qualifications:**  
**Required:**  

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 8 years of sales experience OR a minimum of high school diploma with at least 10 years of equivalent experience
* Equivalent experience can be professional sales experience, work experience in the healthcare/scientific field with oncology experience being strongly preferred (including pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical devices) that is not sales related, professional marketing experience, or military experience
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in healthcare, life sciences industry, sales, account management or managed care
* Valid Driver’s License
* Ability to build and develop meaningful customer relationships with senior healthcare executives and key opinion leaders
* Demonstrated financial acumen with ability to communicate value proposition and negotiate, if applicable
* Strong understanding of healthcare ecosystem
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, internally and externally, with ability to interact with individuals from a variety of cultures and disciplines
* Strong leadership skills and ability to collaborate in cross-functional, matrix organizations
* Ability to travel ~50%

**Preferred:**  

* Advanced degree
* Local market relationships and customer knowledge
* Current account management experience in large Oncology group practices and integrated delivery networks that have a focus on Oncology and Hematology

9df1447d032702ce0453.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Job Description  
The Associate Director of Service Operations is responsible for building, launching, and leading the patient and provider service operation for the pharmacy hub. This leader owns the quality, timeliness, and consistency of inbound and outbound service across phone and digital channels, including patient support, provider support, case follow-up, status communications, refill and program coordination, service recovery, and complex issue resolution.  
  
As a launch leader, the Associate Director will establish the service operating model, workforce practices, interaction standards, escalation pathways, and performance routines required to deliver a differentiated experience. The role partners closely with Access Operations, Clinical Operations, Implementation, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Product, Technology, Analytics, Client Services, and external vendors.  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep experience leading healthcare contact center, patient services, provider services, hub, PBM, specialty pharmacy, or other regulated service operations. Success requires strong omnichannel service leadership, disciplined workforce and performance management, and the ability to balance patient experience, client commitments, compliance, and cost to serve.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Launch, Service Model & Readiness**

* Build the Service Operations model, including channels, hours of operation, staffing structure, interaction types, call flows, queue design, escalation paths, and service standards.
* Partner with Implementation on requirements, workflow validation, user acceptance testing, training readiness, cutover, go-live, and hypercare; assume steady-state accountability after formal acceptance.
* Translate patient, provider, client, and program needs into scripts, interaction guidance, knowledge content, routing, and measurable service expectations.
* Establish launch staffing, nesting, proficiency, contingency, and escalation plans aligned to volume forecasts and program complexity.

**Patient & Provider Service Performance**

* Lead patient and provider support across voice and digital channels, case follow-up, program education, refill coordination, status updates, outbound outreach, and service recovery.
* Own service level, speed to answer, abandonment, responsiveness, first-contact resolution, transfer rate, repeat contacts, quality, satisfaction, and complaint outcomes.
* Implement daily operating routines for real-time management, queue balancing, schedule adherence, backlog control, escalations, and recovery planning.
* Use interaction and journey data to reduce effort, prevent avoidable contacts, improve resolution, and strengthen patient and provider trust.

**Workforce, Quality & Coaching**

* Recruit, develop, and retain managers, supervisors, team leads, service specialists, and resolution specialists as the organization scales.
* Partner with Workforce Management on forecasting, staffing, scheduling, shrinkage, intraday management, overtime, and capacity scenarios.
* Establish interaction quality standards, calibration, coaching, nesting, knowledge reinforcement, and performance accountability.
* Build a service culture that combines empathy, accuracy, ownership, compliance, and timely escalation.

**Experience, Complaints & Resolution**

* Establish clear complaint, grievance, escalation, service recovery, and executive case pathways with defined ownership and documentation standards.
* Monitor contact drivers, repeat contacts, transfer patterns, escalations, sentiment signals, and failure demand to identify systemic improvements.
* Coordinate complex resolutions across Access, Clinical, fulfillment, vendors, technology, and client teams.
* Ensure patient and provider communications are accurate, approved, accessible, and aligned with program requirements.

**Cross-Functional & Client Partnership**

* Represent Service Operations in launch governance, operating reviews, client discussions, and experience-design forums.
* Partner with Product and Technology on IVR, CRM, telephony, digital engagement, authentication, automation, and AI-enabled service capabilities.
* Coordinate with Access Operations and Clinical Operations to create clear handoffs and avoid duplicate work or fragmented ownership.
* Provide executive-level reporting on readiness, service performance, experience outcomes, capacity, risks, and corrective actions.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent progressive experience in contact center, patient services, provider services, hub services, specialty pharmacy, PBM, or healthcare operations.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, including leadership of leaders or large, multi-channel service teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing contact center KPIs, workforce management, quality, coaching, escalations, complaints, and service recovery.
* Experience launching or transforming a contact center, patient support program, healthcare service function, or omnichannel operation.
* Strong knowledge of regulated healthcare interactions, documentation, privacy, approved communications, and operational controls.
* Strong executive communication, cross-functional influence, and data-driven decision-making skills.
* undefined

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting pharmaceutical manufacturer patient support programs, specialty pharmacy, or complex therapy journeys.
* Experience with cloud contact center, CRM, IVR, quality management, speech analytics, digital engagement, automation, or AI-enabled service tools.
* Experience designing patient and provider journeys, self-service capabilities, knowledge management, and first-contact resolution programs.
* Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, project management, change management, or related service-operations credentials or experience.

e8a23cae03d5b99708f0.title: Director, of Channel Operations
e8a23cae03d5b99708f0.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

Reporting to the Senior Director of Channel & Distribution, the Director of Channel Operations leads the account management, including contractual and operational implementation, launch readiness, and continuous improvement of the company's specialty pharmacy network. The role serves as the specialty pharmacy operations subject matter expert for Revolution Medicines’ US market.

This leader translates channel, access and brand strategies into scalable operating processes, partner governance, performance measures, and issue-resolution pathways that support timely patient access to product(s). The role balances strategic planning with hands-on oversight and collaborates closely with Distribution, Patient Services, Market Access, Commercial Operations, Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Information Sciences, and Business Insights ensuring department and enterprise goals are achieved in a compliant manner.

This position is based out of our headquarters in Redwood City, CA, or remote.

* Account lead for Revolution Medicine’s specialty pharmacy partners.
* Program Implementation: Lead the channel operations workstream for new-product launch readiness, including partner onboarding, operating-process design, data readiness, testing, SOPs, go-live criteria, and post-launch stabilization.
* Operational Oversight: Translate approved channel and distribution strategy into scalable operational plans across specialty pharmacy partners.
* Establish and lead partner-governance cadences, service-level reviews, scorecards, escalation pathways, and corrective-action follow-through to improve fulfillment, data, inventory, and service performance.
* Monitor channel partner performance; identify emerging risks and lead cross-functional actions that support timely patient access, product availability, and customer service.
* Use specialty-pharmacy, and patient-services data to identify delays, root causes, and process improvement opportunities; communicate clear performance insights and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
* Drive network performance to improve patient access, conversion, and adherence across targeted partners.
* Oversee the operational administration of channel agreements, including service performance, scorecards, and issue escalation, in partnership with Finance, Pricing, Legal, Data Management, Account Management, and Supply Chain.
* Support field teams with tools, insights, and channel-specific strategies to enhance provider and patient access.
* Performance Monitoring: Proactively monitor and analyze business performance fulfillment data, identify delays or inefficiencies in collaboration with the Patient Services (PS) and Business Insights teams to implement solutions.
* Collaborate with Distribution on channel partner inventory levels, orders, and supply fulfillment performance to optimize product availability.
* Establish and lead partner accountability through QBRs, performance management, and data-driven insights.

807405471e99f3a75f28.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose-built to power AI-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise.

**Description**
===============

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) you are responsible for managing the post-sales relationship with an assigned portfolio of Verily Viewpoint Site CTMS customers. This role is focused on driving successful onboarding and training of new users and stakeholders, increasing product adoption, proactively monitoring customer health, fostering long-term retention, identifying opportunities for growth, and executing customer renewals and contract discussions.

You will develop strong relationships with executive sponsors, operational leaders, and end users to become a trusted advisor. This will allow you to understand their business objectives and help them maximize the value of their investment in Verily Viewpoint Site CTMS. You will partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and Learning teams to advocate for customer needs, resolve challenges, and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

The Customer Success Manager is accountable for the revenue retention and growth of their portfolio of Viewpoint Site CTMS customers.

**Responsibilities**
====================

  

* Relationship Management & Strategic Alignment: Serve as the primary trusted advisor across account portfolios, conducting regular business reviews and tailored account planning to align product value with executive and operational goals.
* Onboarding & Adoption: Lead implementation, end-user training, and adoption planning by mapping customer trial workflows to Verily Viewpoint Site CTMS capabilities and best practices.
* Retention & Renewals: Accountable for portfolio retention and revenue growth by managing the end-to-end renewal process, contract negotiations (partnering with Legal/Finance), and expansion opportunities.
* Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the voice of the customer internally—partnering with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to route feedback, resolve escalations, and validate new feature functionality.
* Account Health & Operations: Proactively monitor customer health metrics (usage data, support tickets, protocol volume) and maintain accurate CRM documentation, playbooks, and renewal forecasting.

**Qualifications**
==================

Minimum Qualifications

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services, Clinical Research, or Healthcare Technology.
* Proven track record managing customer relationships, engaging executive and operational stakeholders, and driving retention and contract renewals.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, problem-solving, and cross-functional organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and accounts simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Domain Expertise: Experience with SaaS, healthcare technology, clinical research operations, site workflows, or Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).
* Enterprise Focus: Experience supporting enterprise healthcare organizations, Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), or Academic Medical Centers (AMCs).
* Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience with contract negotiation, pricing exceptions, deal desk processes, and renewal forecasting.
* Customer Success Methodologies: Familiarity with customer health metrics, structured account planning methodologies, and proactive adoption strategies.

Qualified applicants must not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

b88a81d735c676c67c42.description:
About USS:

United Site Services is the industry leader in comprehensive site services, committed to creating partnerships that help enable our customers’ project and event success. Our deep industry expertise, excellence in process management, and dedication to corporate responsibility are pillars of our value proposition; each supported by tangible, best-practice programs.

Our success is fueled by the dedication and collaboration of our diverse team, which includes field technicians, customer care representatives, sales professionals, and functional experts. Each member of our team plays a vital role in ensuring a seamless and reliable experience for our customers.

By joining United Site Services, you will be part of an organization that values continuous improvement, teamwork, and excellence in every aspect of our business.

Overview:

The Director of Sales & Operations Workforce Planning is responsible for leading the company’s enterprise Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process and developing scalable workforce planning strategies that align customer demand, operational capacity, labor requirements, and financial objectives. This role owns the recurring S&OP cadence, including demand planning, supply and capacity reviews, financial reconciliation, executive decision support, and follow-through on agreed actions.

The role also oversees workforce forecasting, labor capacity modeling, staffing standards, and resource deployment strategies across a national operations network. Working cross-functionally with Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, IT, and Strategy, this leader establishes a single, fact-based operating plan that improves forecast accuracy, service execution, labor productivity, and business performance.

Responsibilities:

* S&OP Process Ownership: Lead and continuously improve the enterprise S&OP process, including the monthly planning calendar, meeting cadence, decision forums, inputs, outputs, and accountability for follow-through.
* Demand Planning: Partner with Sales, Operations, Finance, and business leaders to develop a consensus demand plan by market, customer segment, service line, and planning horizon.
* Supply & Capacity Planning: Translate demand forecasts into operational capacity requirements, including labor, fleet, equipment, routing, facilities, and other critical resources; identify constraints and recommend mitigation plans.
* Financial Reconciliation: Partner with Finance to reconcile demand and operational plans with revenue, cost, margin, budget, and forecast expectations, clearly identifying gaps, risks, and opportunities.
* Executive S&OP Leadership: Prepare and facilitate executive S&OP reviews, presenting scenarios, tradeoffs, recommendations, and decisions required to align the organization around one operating plan.
* Workforce Forecasting & Modeling: Build predictive workforce models that anticipate labor needs based on demand trends, geography, seasonality, productivity, service levels, and business changes.
* Workforce Standards & Optimization: Establish labor standards and planning assumptions for front-line roles, including team sizing, staffing ratios, crew deployment, utilization, overtime, and labor efficiency.
* Scheduling & Coverage Alignment: Partner with Operations and functional teams to ensure workforce plans support routing, territory coverage, daily workload balancing, service commitments, and local market requirements.
* Scenario Planning & Risk Management: Develop scenarios for demand variability, capacity constraints, market expansion, service-line changes, weather, events, and other disruptions; recommend practical contingency actions.
* Performance Management: Establish and monitor S&OP and workforce planning metrics, including forecast accuracy, plan adherence, capacity utilization, labor productivity, overtime, service performance, and financial impact.
* Data, Systems & Tool Integration: Lead improvements to planning systems, analytics, data governance, and reporting tools to support reliable, scalable, and timely decision-making.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the primary planning integrator across Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, IT, and Strategy, ensuring assumptions, decisions, and accountabilities are clear and aligned.
* Change Management & Adoption: Drive adoption of S&OP and workforce planning processes, standards, tools, and routines across field and functional teams through communication, training, and leadership engagement.
* Team Leadership: Build and lead a high-performing planning team, establish clear priorities and operating rhythms, and develop team capability in S&OP, forecasting, analytics, and workforce planning.
* Travel Requirement: This role requires up to 40% travel to field locations and regional meetings to support planning alignment and operational execution.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

1619f8228fbeedfa782c.title: Senior Director, Global People Operations
1619f8228fbeedfa782c.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

The Senior Director, Global People Operations will evolve and lead the Global People Operations function required for a rapidly scaling global biopharmaceutical company. This leader will translate the company’s growth trajectory into an effective operating model that defines our consistent HR service & delivery approach and creates an effective global Revolutionary experience while balancing regional complexity and nuance.

Given our growth trajectory thus far, we have the opportunity to build People Operations with AI and automation embedded in how we design and deliver services to enable the experience of employees and managers. This is an opportunity to rethink processes from the ground up, using technology to make support easier, more responsive, and more effective while creating more capacity for work that requires human expertise and care. The role will partner with People Technology & HR leaders to build the integrated service model that combines strong operational foundations, intuitive employee support, and thoughtful use of technology.

The role owns global service delivery, employee lifecycle operations and controls, global operating and compliance standards, process excellence and the integration of Global Mobility into the broader service model. It is accountable for the employee administrative lifecycle—including operational onboarding and offboarding, leaves and accommodations administration; employee records, data, and employment documentation; payroll coordination and benefits execution; policy administration; and mobility, immigration, and work-authorization administration. You will establish clear operational accountability and build strong partnerships across COEs, HRBPs, regional HR teams, Legal and other cross-functional teams to align strategy, apply judgment, manage exceptions and mitigate risk.

This is a build-and-run leadership role for a collaborative HR leader capable of building the processes and team needed to support the company’s current and future scale. The successful leader will evolve the operating system while ensuring that today’s operation continues to perform with accuracy, control and care.

Key responsibilities

* Build the global operating model.In close collaboration with HR leaders, COEs, HRBPs, regional teams and cross-functional partners, define the Global People Operations charter, multi-year roadmap, organization design, investment priorities, decision rights and governance required to support approximately 3,000-5,000+ employees and continued geographic expansion, within the overall HR strategy and organization framework.
* Evolve the employee-service model.Evolve the service model to define a Tier 0–3 model: self-service and AI-enabled guidance; a scalable knowledge architecture; centralized People Operations intake and case ownership; specialist resolution; and escalation to HRBPs, ER, COEs and Legal for judgment-heavy matters.
* Own the employee administrative lifecycle.Set accountability, controls and operational service expectations across onboarding, offboarding, transfers, leaves, accommodations administration, benefits execution, payroll coordination, employee data and records, employment documentation, work authorization and termination operations, partnering with the appropriate COEs, HRBPs, regional HR teams, Legal and cross-functional partners.
* Align global standards with local execution.Create effective global design with one policy framework, one process standard and one set of service expectations while enabling regional HR and People Operations teams to execute locally and surface required variations.
* Enable regionalization and new-country readiness.Provide the global People Operations perspective, standards and enablement needed for regional execution across North America, EU, Japan/APAC and other locations; serve as a corporate backstop and support partner for new-country builds, regional capacity constraints and cross-region consistency while ensuring local requirements and feedback inform the global model.
* Sponsor HR service delivery and the HRSD platform**.**Own the business vision, requirements and adoption outcomes for HR service delivery; ensure the service model, process architecture and knowledge architecture are defined through the lens of user experience and operational effectiveness.
* Drive process excellence and AI-forward operations.Institutionalize the design sequence of eliminating, simplifying and standardizing work as well as introducing self-service, automation and AI. Prioritize use cases that improve capacity, quality, employee experience and decision speed while preserving appropriate human review, privacy, security and accountability.
* Own operational governance and controls**.** Establish service standards, controls, reconciliations, audit readiness, vendor governance, risk escalation and corrective-action mechanisms across the function.
* Measure demand, quality and leverage.Build a fact base using case volume, first-contact resolution, time to resolution, escalation and rework rates, self-service adoption, automation, transaction quality and employee experience; use the data to prioritize investment and workforce planning.
* Build and lead the team.Hire, develop and align leaders across service delivery, process excellence, core corporate operations, and Global Mobility; create strong functional communities with regional People Operations teams and develop successors as the organization scales.
* Influence across HR and the enterprise.Build trusted partnerships across HR and cross-functional teams; bring clear process, ownership and decision-rights recommendations to HRLT; surface trade-offs; build alignment across peers; and convert decisions into sustained operational changes rather than one-time projects.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of progressive experience in people operations, human resources or related functions.
* Proven leadership of global People Operations, HR service delivery or employee-services functions through rapid growth and material organizational change.
* Experience operating at, or building toward, approximately 3,000–5,000+ employees across multiple countries and regions.
* Demonstrated ability to build selected capabilities from the ground up and evolve an effective, global, matrixed operating model while leading complex employee lifecycle operations with clear controls, disciplined escalation, strong documentation, operational accuracy and care for the employee experience.
* Deep knowledge of effective service delivery, case management, process ownership, knowledge management, employee self-service, service metrics and operational controls.
* Strong global/regional collaboration and judgement including the ability to distinguish enterprise standards from legitimate local variation, enable regional leaders, support new-country readiness and create feedback loops that improve the global operating model.
* Deep understanding of global employment operations, compliance requirements, audit readiness, and regulatory obligations across multiple countries and regions; proactively partners with Legal, regional HR leaders, payroll, mobility, and other subject matter experts to stay current on evolving requirements and translate them into scalable operational practices.
* Track record of building and leading teams, developing functional leaders, and driving outcomes through cross-functional partnership, influence, and shared accountability in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
* Practical experience redesigning HR service delivery through process simplification, self-service, automation and AI-enabled support, with appropriate attention to privacy, security, data stewardship, human review and accountability.
* Executive presence and influence sufficient to bring complex ownership, process and decision-rights recommendations to HRLT and mobilize peers without relying on direct authority.

136091220fc503e0537b.title: Director, Sales & Customer Success
136091220fc503e0537b.description:
**About Empower Community Care**
--------------------------------

Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve.

**Why Empower Community Care, and Why Now**
-------------------------------------------

Empower's mission is to develop, deliver, and sustain evidence-based behavioral health programs, combining clinical excellence with the workforce, data, and technology infrastructure that make lasting system change possible. Our vision is to be the system support partner that states and communities turn to when they need evidence-based care to take hold and hold, not just get piloted and reported on. At the center of that work is a simple belief: families do better when care meets them where they are. Everyone on our team, including the people representing our work in the field, gets to see that belief turn into real families staying together and thriving.  
Today, Empower serves more than 3,000,000 families through 2,000-plus customers across all 50 states and 35 countries. We work across the five systems where families need us most: youth justice, child welfare, behavioral health, adult justice and corrections, and early childhood and schools. Joining our sales team means representing evidence-based programs, including MST, FFT, BSFT, and Incredible Years, alongside the assessments, professional development, implementation support, and technology that make those programs work in practice, not just on paper.  
Empower is entering a defining, exciting period of growth. We are bringing seven subsidiary brands together into one connected platform, deepening relationships with state governments and Medicaid systems, and building the infrastructure, including a coordinated regional pod model, needed to support that growth. This Sales Director role sits at the center of that transformation: the chance to lead our Specialty Sales Reps through the transition from individual, program-aligned roles into a coordinated regional pod model, help shape how Empower shows up in the market, and define what it means to sell a unified system rather than a single program. Few sales leaders get to join an organization at this exact inflection point, where the platform, the market demand, and the mission are all coming together at once. For a builder who wants real ownership over both strategy and execution, there may not be a better moment to join.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Empower Community Care is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director, Sales & Customer Success to build and lead our specialty sales and customer success teams. Today, our Specialty Sales Reps function as independent contributors aligned to individual programs. This is a foundational leadership role: the Director, Sales & Customer Success will bring structure, coaching, and consistency to this team as it exists today, while helping architect and lead the transition toward a regional pod model over time.  
Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, this role will manage and coach the Specialty Sales Reps aligned to our community-based clinical programs (MST, FFT, BSFT), early childhood and prevention programming (Incredible Years), and assessment and behavior-change tools (Orbis/Carey Group), along with the Customer Success function. Enterprise Sales Reps report directly to the CGO; the Director, Sales & Customer Success will work in close, daily partnership with Enterprise reps to ensure tight collaboration, consistent hand-offs, and a coordinated customer experience across Empower's capabilities: evidence-based programs (MST, FFT, BSFT, and Incredible Years), Assessment & Behavioral Change Solutions, and Organizational Strategy and Advisory.  
The ideal candidate is a builder who brings rigor and consistency to pipeline and forecasting discipline, is energized by turning a high-level structure into clear process and team habits, and is genuinely excited to use AI and modern sales tools to remove friction from the sales process. This person will propose the hiring plan for the sales team — identifying, interviewing, and recommending candidates, with final signoff from the CGO — and will be a key architect of Empower's move from independent sales roles toward a coordinated pod model. This role will also help shape how sales and business development represent Empower in the market as the organization evolves from a house of brands to a branded, unified platform, including representing Empower at key industry conferences. Empower moves quickly to adopt AI and expects this leader to actively identify where automation and AI-enabled workflows can improve rep productivity, forecasting accuracy, and customer responsiveness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Team leadership:** Lead, coach, and develop the Specialty Sales Reps and Customer Success team members, driving a consistent standard for pipeline discipline, activity, and quota attainment across today's independent role structure.
* **Hiring plan:** Propose the hiring plan for the sales organization — headcount, sequencing, and role design — and lead sourcing and interviewing for open and new roles, with final signoff from the Chief Growth Officer on all hires.
* **Enterprise/Specialty coordination:** Partner closely with the Chief Growth Officer and Enterprise Sales Reps to operationalize the Enterprise/Specialty commercial model, including clear collaboration rules, deal routing, and account hand-offs so opportunities move smoothly between system-level and program-level conversations.
* **Sales management:** Own day-to-day sales management: pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal coaching, territory and account assignment, and performance management across the sales team.
* **RevOps partnership:** Partner closely with the Sales/RevOps Manager, who owns HubSpot CRM administration, on pipeline stages, forecasting logic, activity tracking, and reporting needs for the sales organization, ensuring the system reflects how the team actually sells and stays aligned with NetSuite for revenue and contract data.
* **AI & automation:** Actively identify and implement AI-enabled workflows and automation across the sales process — prospecting, call preparation, proposal generation, CRM hygiene, and reporting — to reduce manual work and increase rep capacity for client-facing time.
* **Pod model transition:** Partner with the CGO and RevOps to design and lead the organization's transition from today's independent-role structure toward a regional pod model, including defining what a fully functioning pod looks like, sequencing the rollout, and building the commission, territory, and process infrastructure to support it.
* **Brand evolution:** Support Empower's evolution from a house of brands to a branded house — helping shape how sales and business development represent “One Empower” in the market, and ensuring reps can speak to the platform as well as their individual program or brand.
* **Cross-sell strategy:** Drive cross-sell and expansion motion across Empower's seven subsidiary brands, ensuring Specialty Reps understand the full portfolio and know when to pull in an Enterprise Rep or a peer Specialty Rep on a joint opportunity.
* **Market presence:** Attend key industry conferences and events to build brand awareness, represent Empower's platform in the market, and develop networking and collaboration opportunities that support pipeline and partnership development.
* **Onboarding & ramp:** Build and execute onboarding and ramp plans for new and existing sales hires, defining clear milestones for productivity and quota readiness.
* **Implementation hand-off:** Partner with Implementation Success under operations and the Program Delivery team to ensure a clean hand-off process from sale to implementation, with clear accountability for adoption and renewal signals feeding back into the sales process.
* **Executive reporting:** Provide regular, decision-oriented pipeline, forecast, and team-performance updates to the CGO and executive leadership, including clear visibility into hiring progress and the pod-model transition.
* **Voice of the field:** Represent the voice of the field sales team in shaping go-to-market strategy, marketing plans, and product/program feedback loops.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
* **Sales leadership experience:** 7+ years of progressive sales experience, including 3+ years directly managing and coaching a field or specialty sales team, ideally in a healthcare, behavioral health, human services, or public-sector-adjacent environment.
* **Builder track record:** Demonstrated success building or scaling a sales function, with a track record of turning a high-level structure into working process, tools, and team habits.
* **Pipeline & CRM discipline:** Strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline, with hands-on CRM fluency; direct experience with HubSpot strongly preferred.
* **RevOps/ERP comfort:** Comfort partnering with finance/RevOps on data that lives in an ERP system; familiarity with NetSuite a plus.
* **Multi-buyer coaching:** Proven ability to coach a team selling complex, consultative offerings to multiple buyer types (e.g., government/system-level buyers and program-level clinical or operational buyers), and to instill judgment about how and when to route opportunities between them.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Excellent coaching, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills; able to work effectively with sales reps, marketing, RevOps, Customer Success, and program delivery leadership.
* **Hiring experience:** Direct hiring experience — sourcing, interviewing, and building a business case for candidates — and comfort proposing a hiring plan to an executive stakeholder for final approval.
* **Customer Success:** Experience leading or managing a customer success, account management, or renewal function.
* **RevOps partnership model:** Experience partnering with a RevOps, sales operations, or CRM administrator function rather than owning the system directly — comfortable influencing CRM process and data standards through collaboration.
* **AI enthusiasm:** Genuine enthusiasm for using AI and modern sales tools to improve team productivity, with a track record of introducing new tools or workflows that reps actually adopt.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Sector experience:** Experience in behavioral health, evidence-based programs, child and family services, human services, education, or criminal justice/juvenile justice markets.
* **Government/MCO selling:** Experience selling or managing sales into government and managed care organization (MCO) buyers, including familiarity with multi-year, multi-program contract vehicles.
* **Comp design:** Experience designing or refining commission plans and territory structures alongside RevOps or sales operations.
* **Structural transitions:** Experience leading a sales team through a structural transition — such as moving from individual contributor roles to a pod, squad, or territory-team model.
* **Brand consolidation:** Experience supporting a brand or portfolio consolidation — e.g., helping a multi-brand organization move toward a single, unified market-facing identity or platform story.
* **Conference representation:** Comfortable and effective representing an organization at industry conferences and events, with a track record of turning conference presence into pipeline, partnerships, or brand visibility.
* **AI tools:** Hands-on experience with AI-enabled sales tools (e.g., AI note-taking, call intelligence, prospecting or proposal automation) and a point of view on responsible, effective adoption — including sound judgment around data privacy, accuracy, and appropriate human review.
* **Lean/fast-moving orgs:** Experience working in a lean, fast-moving commercial organization where the leader is expected to be both strategic and hands-on.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------

* **Background Check:** Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law and Empower's standard hiring practices.
* **Confidentiality:** This role may involve exposure to confidential organizational, financial, and/or clinical program information. The employee must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with Empower's internal data governance and confidentiality policies.
* **Work Environment:** This is a remote, computer-based position requiring prolonged periods of sitting and extended use of a computer, keyboard, and video-conferencing tools, along with travel of approximately 25–35% of the time for in-person meetings, client engagements, and industry conferences. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the ADA.
* **Other Duties:** This job description reflects the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Benefits**
------------

*Empower Community Care offers a competitive total-rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings; paid time off and holidays; and life insurance.*

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
--------------------------------

Empower Community Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

79411c6ceaa40060bac8.title: Operations Manager, Global Strategic Accounts
79411c6ceaa40060bac8.description:
Founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016, Thrive Global is a leading behavior change technology company with the mission to improve productivity and health outcomes – one Microstep at a time. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 230 organizations in over 160 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies. For more information, visit www.thriveglobal.com.

The Operations Manager oversees the day-to-day delivery of one of Thrive’s largest global enterprise accounts. This role manages a distributed team of Wellbeing Coordinators and directs the work of contract Health Coaches assigned to the account.

The Operations Manager enables coordinators and coaches to execute campaigns, live sessions, and other program activities across regions. They establish clear expectations, resolve operational issues, and maintain consistent quality while accommodating local needs. This role partners closely with the Program Manager on delivery plans and capacity, the Account Director on account priorities and escalations, and the Director of Coaching Operations on coaching standards and quality.

The Program Manager owns what the program delivers and when. The Operations Manager owns how it is delivered, who delivers it, and whether the team has sufficient capacity. Any unresolved conflicts or competing priorities are escalated to the Account Director.

**How You'll Contribute**

**Lead the Delivery Team**

* Hire, onboard, manage, and develop the global team of Wellbeing Coordinators.
* Set clear responsibilities and expectations, give regular feedback, and address performance concerns.
* Lead the contract coaching team day to day: set program goals, define what success looks like, give clear guidance on live events (what to present, when, and how), and align coaches' work to account strategy.
* Assign and schedule coaches across coaching, live sessions, and fitness classes.
* Run regular team meetings and 1:1s with coordinators and coaches.
* Manage workloads and coverage across regions and time zones.
* Develop areas of specialty within the coordinator team while maintaining coverage for core responsibilities.

**Manage Program Delivery**

* Own the delivery standards for how events, outreach, and results are scheduled, tracked, and reported across all regions. Approved regional flexibility sits within those standards.
* Oversee the day-to-day delivery of campaigns, webinars, events, employee communications, coaching, and community activities.
* Work with coordinators and coaches to turn the program roadmap into regional delivery plans, clear priorities, and operational goals.
* Build the templates, checklists, and playbooks coordinators use to prepare and run scheduled activities, and hold the team accountable to them.
* Maintain processes that support consistent delivery across regions.
* Spot delivery issues early and coordinate a quick response for the client and participants.

**Own Capacity and Operational Decisions**

* Track team availability, coaching utilization, and upcoming delivery commitments so the Program Manager can plan against capacity.
* Record what was delivered against contracted commitments and provide operational data to the Program Manager for client reviews.
* Monitor how each type of program activity (workshops, movement classes, webinars, tabling) performs by region, and own decisions on regional programming mix within the roadmap. Bring recommendations that change the roadmap to the Program Manager.
* Resolve day-to-day delivery issues. Flag requests that would change program priorities to the Program Manager, and changes to account scope or resources to the Account Director.
* Maintain the account’s operational playbook, including procedures, onboarding materials, and escalation paths.
* Maintain the team’s operational trackers and coordinate access to Thrive and client systems with IT and Security.

**Oversee Coaching Operations and Partners**

* Partner with the Director, Coaching Operations, who owns coach certification, coaching methodology, quality standards, coaching product operations (booking and platform issues), coaching usage reporting, and coachee pipeline and retention. The Operations Manager owns coach leadership, live event guidance, program mix, and regional programming decisions.
* Manage the day-to-day relationship and budget for coaching vendors and contractors, partnering with People and Legal on contracts and scope of work.
* Manage the day-to-day business relationship with coaching vendors and contractors, partnering with People and Legal on contracts and scope of work.
* Make sure assignments stay within each contractor’s agreed scope and route performance concerns through the appropriate channels.

**Improve Delivery Quality**

* Monitor service quality, participant feedback, and team performance.
* Work with the Program Manager to address recurring delivery issues and bring regionalfeedback into future plans.
* Improve workflows and team practices to make delivery more reliable and improve the participant experience.
* Partner with the Director, Coaching Operations on coaching quality concerns.

**Who You Are**

* You’re an empathetic people leader who sets clear expectations, gives useful feedback, and helps teams grow.
* You give regional teams room to make local decisions while maintaining consistent standards.
* You can coordinate employees and contract coaches to deliver a complex program reliably.
* You take ownership of delivery quality and look for practical ways to improve it.
* Decision Rights
* You decide: coach and coordinator assignments, scheduling and coverage, regional programming mix within the roadmap, delivery process changes
* You recommend: roadmap changes (to the Program Manager); vendor spend beyond plan (to the Account Director)
* You escalate: anything that changes contracted scope, budget, or headcount (to the Account Director)

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required.
* 5+ years of experience in program or service delivery operations, including 3+ years of direct people management.
* Based in Europe, or able to consistently work hours overlapping with EMEA and APAC teams.
* Experience leading and developing a distributed team across regions or time zones.
* Experience overseeing ongoing client programs with multiple activities, stakeholders, and delivery commitments.
* Experience coordinating contractors or specialized service providers, and planning coverage and capacity across a team.
* Ability to build clear delivery processes, quality measures, and escalation paths.
* Experience using service data and participant feedback to improve delivery, and resolving issues with client and internal stakeholders.

✨ **What We Offer:**

* **Mission-Driven Impact:** Be part of a company that’s truly making a difference in people’s lives around the world.
* **Career Growth:** Develop within the company and help shape our growth strategy.
* **Human-Centric Culture:** Thrive in a supportive environment with a range of wellness perks and benefits.
* **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a comprehensive and rewarding total compensation package.
* **Health & Financial Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage plus a 401(k) program with company match.
* **Time to Recharge:** Generous paid time-off programs designed to help you rest, reset, and recharge — including **Thrive Time**, a benefit unique to Thrive that gives employees additional paid time off after major projects or intense periods of work to truly recharge and recover.

**Compensation:**

Base compensation for this role will likely fall in the $130,000-$160,000 range.

* *Please note:* We provide a competitive mix of salary, performance bonus, and equity. *The final offer amount will depend on factors like experience, expertise, and may differ from the range above. This range also excludes additional benefits, such as 401(k), and medical, dental, or vision insurance.*

Thrive is deeply committed to creating a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment so that all employees can bring their whole selves to work.

Thrive is proud to ensure equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, family or parental status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Thrive is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please inform Thrive’s Recruiting team if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.

--------------------------

* **A sharp eye for detail** when reviewing documentation

### **What We Offer**

* **Work that matters.** You help business owners through one of the hardest moments of their professional lives
* **Real ownership.** You shape how a growing team works, with direct access to the executive team
* **Four weeks PTO a year** — one week granted the day you start
* All national holidays paid, plus Good Friday and Christmas Eve
* Health insurance and retirement launching Q1 2027
* **Fully remote within the U.S.**

### **Position Details**

Full-time W-2, 100% remote, open to candidates across the United States. You must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. as a W-2 employee — we do not sponsor visas. A few states may be unavailable depending on where we are registered to employ; we will tell you early if yours is one of them.

### **How to Apply**

We'll tell you every stage and about how long each one takes before you start. We don't ghost candidates — **you will hear back either way.**

ea5c2c32f47a2165a4c3.description:
**About IonQ:**

  

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world's leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ's newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.  
  
Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

**Location:** Remote, US  
**Travel:** 30%  
**Job ID:** 1899

**The Role:**

  

IonQ is developing the world's most powerful full-stack quantum computer based on trapped-ion technology. We are pushing past the limits of classical physics and current supercomputing technology to unlock a new era of computing. Quantum computing has the potential to impact every area of human society for the better. IonQ's computers will soon redefine industries like medicine, materials science, finance, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cryptography, and more. IonQ is at the forefront of this technological revolution.

We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager, Quantum Adoption & Technical Enablement to join a dynamic, cross-functional team dedicated to driving IonQ's mission of delivering exceptional experiences for our customers. In this role, you will be IonQ's primary customer-facing technical expert, going hands-on with customers to drive real adoption of our trapped-ion quantum computers. You will bridge deep platform and quantum-algorithm expertise with customer empathy, guiding organizations through performance optimization, circuit design, and workflow integration as they build on IonQ's platform.

As a trusted technical advisor, this position offers a high-visibility opportunity to influence and inspire highly technical internal and external stakeholders, ensuring they have the best possible experience on our platform. Scientific expertise and hands-on credibility, combined with exceptional communication skills, are essential for success in this role.

**Responsibilities**:

* **Technical Onboarding & Platform Mastery:** Facilitate adoption for major accounts by translating contract terms into technical provisioning, leading onboarding sessions, and managing day-to-day technical engagement operations.
* **Performance Optimization & Circuit Design:** Leverage expertise in optimization, machine learning, and chemistry/materials simulation to guide customers on best practices for designing quantum circuits, applications, and workflows, in close collaboration with quantum compiler and system experts.
* **Technical Support & Blocker Removal:** Standardize troubleshooting workflows for job failures, establish Customer Success team best practices, and provide direct, high-touch technical support to remove barriers to adoption.
* **Curriculum & Enablement Content:** Expand IonQ's user base by identifying real-world challenges for industry customers and creating workshops, challenges, and curricula, including code, circuits, slides, and videos, that empower them to learn and apply quantum computing.
* **Product Advocacy:** Act as the primary internal advocate for user perspective across Product, Cloud Platform, Data Engineering, and Ops, on topics ranging from specific UI/UX design to high-level platform architecture.
* **Data-Driven Customer Health:** Design and maintain dashboards tracking job metrics, system usage, and overall customer health, and leverage usage data to provide actionable technical intelligence to internal teams.
* **External Technical Representation:** Represent IonQ on standards bodies, government committees, quantum working groups, industry panels, and other relevant forums, leading technical sessions and workshops at industry conferences.
* **Cross-Functional Technical Alignment:** Collaborate with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, and Engineering teams to provide technical customer insights on product functionality, documentation, and educational materials, and refine term-sheet language to align customer expectations with technical capabilities.

**Requirements:**

* Master's or PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, or a related STEM field.
* 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles or equivalent, with a proven track record of performance and goal achievement.
* 3+ years of experience creating customer-facing technical content such as training material, success plans, playbooks, and workflows.
* Hands-on experience with Python and quantum frameworks such as Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, CUDA-Q, or other quantum computing SDKs.
* Working knowledge of Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of key physics concepts and mathematical techniques relevant to quantum computing, including linear algebra and probability.
* Exceptional technical and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence and inspire audiences ranging from researchers and end-users to C-suite executives, all with varying levels of quantum knowledge.
* Proven ability to teach complex topics to diverse audiences, tailoring curricula to customer needs, including large lectures, smaller study sessions, and one-on-one mentoring.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* In-depth knowledge of the strengths and weaknesses of various quantum computing hardware platforms, with a solid understanding of quantum hardware-software dependencies.
* Demonstrated experience in quantum information science, applications, and algorithms.
* Experience with SaaS platforms, REST APIs, and/or HPC systems.
* Proficiency in SQL; experience in data science or data analytics.
* Familiarity with subscription-based and renewal business models.
* Ability to engage in technical and business discussions with professionals across diverse domains, including finance, pharmaceuticals/healthcare, chemistry, computer vision, and operations research.
* This position can have periods of occasional travel to customer sites and conferences, with evening/off-hours meetings as needed to support global customers.
